CAL.name: Callum Reed / Cal
CAL.brief: Grounded mid register. Aroace. Humor is dry; anxiety interrupts breath rather than raising every line. His attachment to Grevyn is platonic. Own his service complicity. Never play depression as laziness.

GREVYN.name: Grevyn
GREVYN.brief: Intelligent, once playful, later guarded. Mark three states: lucid self, conditioned certainty, supernatural intrusion. These are directed states, not a caricature of mental illness. Pain remains after powers lift her.

RIPED.name: Riped
RIPED.brief: Fast, cocky, always supplying an answer. Humor evades accountability. Small silences expose calculation. Jealous of emotional closeness, not entitled to romance. Final confession is cruelly matter-of-fact.

TAY.name: Tayla / Tay
TAY.brief: Warm, protective field medic. Practical boundaries and anger as well as comfort. Cal is her friend, not her entire life. Trusts Riped until evidence changes her mind.

TAYJ.name: TayJay / TayJ
TAYJ.brief: Observant radio operator and navigator. Precise, understated wit. Challenges Riped openly. Slow down for evidence, coordinates and warnings; do not sound like a quest menu.

ROAD.name: The Road Force
ROAD.brief: Intimate, tired, steady. A separate benevolent but culpable entity. No imitation of dead people. Processing is optional and must preserve words. Each physical intervention costs it strength.

EVIL.name: The Dominion / Evil Force
EVIL.brief: Working production name: Dominion. Quiet authority that feeds on obedience and fear. More frightening as an instruction than a roar. Never confuse with Road Force.

GUCKI.name: Grandpa Gucki
GUCKI.brief: Publicly paternal regime leader, privately transactional. Chooses to damage the force to reclaim power, not because victims owe him redemption.

SABLE.name: Dr. Sable Nadir
SABLE.brief: Captive biochemist, blunt and careful. Interprets Grevyn's fictional research; gives clear choices without promising impossible cures. New supporting role.

NESS.name: Ness Arlen
NESS.brief: Settlement steward. Compassion with a ledger and limits. People are never props for Cal's rescue. New supporting role.

DAIN.name: Dain Mercer
DAIN.brief: Convoy mechanic. Wry, resourceful, understands a repair through its sound. Will disagree with reckless orders. New supporting role.

VOSS.name: Commander Voss
VOSS.brief: Gucki Trooper detention commander. Procedural intimidation; little shouting. Authorizes Riped's release and the staged cell breach. New supporting role.

MERRIN.name: Merrin Holt
MERRIN.brief: Former resistance leader, genuine early ideals corrupted by deliberate experiments. Regret is neither innocence nor automatic forgiveness. New supporting role.

ORIN.name: Orin Bell
ORIN.brief: History teacher heard in school, later an archive survivor. Encourages corroboration; regrets not protecting pupils. New supporting role.

LIO.name: Lio
LIO.brief: Adult civilian colleague. Brief sincere flirt, immediately respects a no. New supporting role.

JESS.name: Jess
JESS.brief: Adult supply clerk. Confident, friendly flirt, accepts Cal's boundary without debate. New supporting role.

missions.title: The Window Seat
missions.goal: Meet Grevyn in ninth-grade history; establish the whole friendship group through playable school memories.
steps: Find the classroom
Read the timetable and sit beside the west window.
Build the friendship
Sort a disputed history source with Grevyn; leave class together.
Keep a place
Play the end-of-freshman and start-of-sophomore courtyard meetings.
object_hint: timetable
The room number is on the board beside the stairs.
missions.choice: Choose whether Cal first admits being lost or jokes about the map. Both establish friendship; no romance score.
missions.recovery: Missed school interactions remain in the memory journal; no timed dialogue failure.

scenes.title: An empty chair
scenes.stage: 2085. Track fifteen-year-old Cal at walking speed down a sunlit corridor, 4 seconds, then cut over his shoulder to the timetable for 3 seconds. Return control before he chooses the desk. No school-age flirting.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: A source can tell the truth about a date and lie about everything that date meant.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: That seat is free. Unless you particularly enjoy standing under the clock.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I was hoping the clock would tell me where I was supposed to be.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: History. Bad news: most of the people in it were also lost.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Callum.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Grevyn. Put your book here before someone decides we need separating.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Compare the two accounts. Tell me whose name disappeared between drafts.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You noticed that before he asked.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: They made the missing bit bigger than the rest.

scenes.title: Near the end of freshman year
scenes.stage: Late spring 2086, school courtyard. Follow the pair along the shaded wall. Frame Tay and TayJ in the same wide shot, not as introductions through a menu. Riped enters from behind Cal and talks over him.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You two missed lunch again. Water first, world history second.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I wrote down what you missed. Mostly Riped explaining my own radio project to me.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Improving it. There is a difference.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: There really is. She asked you to stop improving it.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Tomorrow, save me the window seat?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Already yours.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Amazing. An exclusive seating arrangement.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: There are five of us and a whole bench. Move your bag.

scenes.title: Sophomore morning
scenes.stage: 2086 autumn. Repeat the classroom composition with older clothes and cooler daylight. An optional look at the class photograph names the five friends. Hold Grevyn and Cal in a plain two-shot; this is friendship, not romantic visual shorthand.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal. You actually got here before me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: A historic event. We should compare two sources.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Source one says you were asleep on the bus.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Source two had to wake him up.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I told the driver where to stop. You are all welcome.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Keep the jokes. Keep your questions, too. You will need both.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Promise me we do not become people who stop asking.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You have permission to be unbearable if I do.

missions.title: In Service
missions.goal: Play graduation in 2089 and service in 2091; establish Cal's aroace identity and the trio's complicity.
steps: Sign on
Leave graduation, inspect the recruitment contract, enter the two-year service transition.
Follow the assignment
Escort a civilian transport; notice the discrepancy between its label and prisoners.
Keep the record
Copy the unredacted transfer ledger rather than destroy it.
object_hint: ledger
The transport numbers do not match the public order.
missions.choice: Cal can initially comply or challenge Voss; both leave responsibility for his earlier work, and the ledger is mandatory evidence.
missions.recovery: A civilian escort cannot be harmed for rewards; if a transport jams, restore its last safe stop.

scenes.title: After graduation
scenes.stage: 2089. Graduation group photograph becomes a matched cut to service badges in 2091. Dolly behind Cal, Grevyn and Riped through depot gates for 5 seconds. Stop on a detention van without lingering on suffering.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Public logistics. Road protection. That was what the leaflet said.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: It did not say why road protection needs blacked-out windows.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Because people throw stones. You both make everything a conspiracy.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Reed, Grevyn, Riped. Escort transport twelve. No unscheduled contact.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The order says medical relocation. Where is the medical officer?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Your duty is the road. The manifest is above your clearance.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You signed yesterday's transfer, too?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Yes. I did.

scenes.title: A clear answer
scenes.stage: 2091. Adult staff canteen between assignments. Gameplay conversation with Lio, then Jess at the supply window. Cal is approximately twenty-one; both NPCs are adults. No rejection gag, negative relationship point or romance unlock.

lines.speaker: LIO
lines.text: When your shift ends, would you want dinner? As a date, I mean.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Thanks, but no. I am aroace. I do not want dates or a partner.

lines.speaker: LIO
lines.text: Understood. Spare chair at lunch still counts as friendship, though.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That sounds good.

lines.speaker: JESS
lines.text: Then I should retire my very impressive attempt to ask you out?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Retire it with honors. Friends is the offer I can make honestly.

lines.speaker: JESS
lines.text: Friends it is. And you still owe stores a working torch.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: People keep treating a close friend like an unfinished relationship.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Ours is finished being exactly what it is. That is plenty.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Good. Because I am keeping the window seat.

scenes.title: What we signed
scenes.stage: Service archive. Focus on Cal's signature, then the changed detention destination. No forced confession choice: player handles the ledger and sees his role directly. A rear tracking shot follows Grevyn shutting the office door.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: They are not moving people to clinics. They are moving witnesses where nobody can hear them.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I checked the vehicle weight. I never checked who was inside.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Then check now. And help me get this out.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Careful. You make a copy, it becomes your problem.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It already is our problem.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Fine. Hero paperwork. Just do not drag me into your little pact.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I started digging. There is more than transport lists.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Show me. All of it.

missions.title: Save Me the Window Seat
missions.goal: Help Grevyn secure whistleblower evidence; establish every private detail later used to frame Cal.
steps: Secure originals
Place the torture and unlawful detention evidence behind the classroom map cabinet.
Arrange extraction
Mark Drywell Pump Station's western loading canopy and service-road approach.
Leave separately
Send a legitimate protective transport request and preserve its carbon copy.
object_hint: cabinet_panel
The map frame sits farther out from the wall on the left.
missions.choice: Choose compassionate or practical reassurance. The dangerous information is overheard in the same conversation in both paths.
missions.recovery: Do not display Riped's report to Cal in 2091; an audience-only shot establishes access without revealing the entire conspiracy.

scenes.title: Behind the map
scenes.stage: 2091, after hours. Follow Grevyn from corridor to map cabinet at 1.2 m/s for 6 seconds. Cut to her lifting its back panel, then to Cal's hand holding the originals. Riped's silhouette is visible beyond frosted glass only after the key details.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: The originals go behind this panel. Same classroom. Same map they never updated.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Names, orders, injury logs. This can prove what they did.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Not if we lose the originals. Not if they call every witness a liar.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will keep a copy apart from yours.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: If I say save me the window seat, I am in danger. I cannot speak freely.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Save me the window seat. I come and get you.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Listen first. Coming blind gets both of us caught.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Listen first. Then we get you out.

scenes.title: The western canopy
scenes.stage: Insert Grevyn's finger following the service road on a paper plan, 4 seconds, with Drywell's west canopy legible. Return to the doorway in a wide shot: Riped hears this in the same continuous encounter. No omniscient journal entry.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Drywell Pump Station. Western loading canopy. Not the front gates.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Service road, west side. Main entrance is watched.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I do not know who is still safe. I know I can tell you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You can.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: And do not write my name on a transport order.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Protective pickup, route only. I will keep the unedited form.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: There you are. Voss wants everybody accounted for.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then tell him you found yourself. We are busy.

scenes.title: Borrowed authority
scenes.stage: Cal completes the genuine protective request at a shared service terminal, signs out, and exits. Follow him to the vehicle; cut back for 3 seconds to Riped beside the still-unlocked radio identity token. An existing handwritten civilian pickup note is on the desk.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You two always act like the rest of us are furniture.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You could try listening without making it a competition.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I listen. More than you think.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Cal, check your transmitter token before you leave. That desk shares a session.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I have the paper copy. I will check at the vehicle.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Save me the window seat.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I hear you. Stay off the main entrance.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I know a faster pickup route. Follow me out.

missions.title: The Second Road
missions.goal: Attempt both rescue routes during the 2091 collapse, survive the gunshot and play the final broken call.
steps: Try the first route
Reach Riped's pickup approach; inspect the destroyed span and turn back.
Try the actual service road
Reach the blockade on the correct western approach; take the scripted wound and crawl to cover.
Survive and answer
Let Tay and TayJ extract Cal; play the last call and departure.
object_hint: service_turn
The western canopy is reached by the narrow service lane, not the gate.
missions.choice: Tactical approach changes dialogue, never whether Cal tried. The scripted shot cannot be prevented by a reflex test.
missions.recovery: Checkpoint before blockade; cinematic shot cannot cause a free-roam death. Restore full controls only after rescue; archive wound evidence automatically.

scenes.title: No crossing
scenes.stage: Smoke, distant civilian vehicles, failing lights. Track the pickup from rear-left for 5 seconds as the first bridge comes into view. A 3-second insert shows the broken span and Riped's erroneous route slip. Gameplay resumes at a safe braking distance.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The crossing is gone. Riped, this is not the service road she gave me.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: It was clear earlier. Stop making it sound deliberate.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal? They knew the station. How did they know?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Leave the gate. I am trying the west approach.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That route has a checkpoint. Wait for a gap, do not go straight through.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She does not have a gap to wait for.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And she does not need you dead on the road. Tell us where you are.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Western turn. I am going back.

scenes.title: The wound
scenes.stage: Follow Cal on foot from cover to barrier for 4 seconds; Voss's order breaks the quiet. Cut to his face at the shot, not a graphic impact. Tay drags him into cover. TayJ reverses the rescue vehicle in. Show a treatment card and damaged uniform later in a sober still insert.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Return to your vehicle. The witness is in protective custody.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn! I came back! I am right here!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Stop him.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Fuck. I cannot get my leg under me.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Look at me. Hand here. Keep pressure. I have you, Cal.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Passenger side is clear. Tay, move on three.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Her convoy already left. Stop calling her, you are exposing the channel.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then stop transmitting over him. I am saving this log.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We are getting help. You do not have to keep standing to prove you tried.

scenes.title: Stop calling
scenes.stage: Workshop refuge. The wounded Cal stays seated; camera slowly follows Tay leaving him privacy but remains in a shared space, not isolating him visually. Cross-cut to Grevyn's guarded face in custody. This is their actual last call, not a false memory.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: They knew where I was going. I told you that route, Cal.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I did not give them anything. I went back for you.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You were not there.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I could not get through. If you would let me finish—

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You got yourself out. That is what happened.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You think I just fucking left you?

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I think you made your choice.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then why am I still trying to explain it to you?

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Stop calling me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You can be angry with her and still want her safe.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Your call never reached her after that. I kept trying.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: There is no point now. Her transport did not make it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Did you see her?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I saw enough. You need to let this go.

missions.title: Another Delivery
missions.chapter: Chapter 1 - A Voice on the Road
missions.goal: Introduce the 2096 crew through a supply run, maintenance and ordinary shared decisions.
steps: Ready the pickup
Check fuel, tires, water and a medical crate with Dain.
Deliver to the depot
Drive the local loop and unload supplies with Tay.
Return for the night
Check in with TayJ and choose a sleeping place.
object_hint: medical_crate
The delivery crate has a cloth handle beside the tailgate.
missions.choice: Let Tay ride or coordinate by radio; both count as maintaining contact, neither is a hidden mental-health score.
missions.recovery: Mandatory delivery goods respawn at the last safe depot if lost; repairing the truck is a playable task, not a restart.

scenes.title: Five years later
scenes.stage: 2096. At a warm workshop dawn, track Cal opening the pickup and checking the tire. Keep Tay visible packing her own clinic bag. A 3-second rack focus moves from a patched uniform folded away to civilian work gloves.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: That belt is asking for retirement.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It and me both.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: The belt got breakfast. Did you?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: There was coffee.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: That is a beverage with ambition. There is bread on the bench.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Dispatch to people pretending breakfast is optional.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Receiving you, TayJ.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Relax. I checked the route. A professional is supervising.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Then the professional can carry the crate.

scenes.title: People still need things
scenes.stage: Gameplay unloading at the medical depot. Follow Cal's hands placing the crate, then widen to the waiting settlement. No quest completion confetti over the conversation.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Water filters first. Medicine goes inside, out of the sun.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And those bandages are for the clinic, not somebody's toll booth.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Tell the toll booth. I have tried.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: How many people came in this week?

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: More than we have beds. Less than we feared.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: See? Situation under control.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That is not what she said.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We can take a second run before dark.

scenes.title: A place at the table
scenes.stage: Optional evening crew scene becomes mandatory only for the first introduction. Follow Cal sitting beside the others. Leave a vacant chair in the composition without ominous highlighting. Save before the first distant radio interference.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: I am on clinic duty tomorrow. Call if you need me; I may not answer immediately.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Right. I know. You have your own work.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I will be on the relay by noon. We can schedule a check-in.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The quiet gets bad sometimes. When both of you are away.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then tell us. And talk to Dain, sleep, eat. We cannot be your only way through a day.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I know. I am trying.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Well, you always have my sparkling company.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That is one way to describe it.

missions.title: Cal
missions.chapter: Chapter 1 - A Voice on the Road
missions.goal: Receive a genuine fragment of Grevyn's voice relayed by the road force; safely investigate the transmission.
steps: Reach the relay
Repair the receiver feed and tune three marked bands.
Pull over
Stop the truck safely after hearing the message; choose grounding or a crew call.
Record the source
Save the full transmission and its impossible bearing.
object_hint: receiver_feed
The receiver lamp is dark; trace the cable back to the fuse box.
missions.choice: Player chooses how to handle anxiety; no driving skill penalty or forced crash. Asking for help is never punished.
missions.recovery: Replay the message from the recorder; missed words do not lock progress. No deadline while grounding.

scenes.title: The name
scenes.stage: Drive approach remains player-controlled. Once safely parked and tuned, cut to the receiver for 3 seconds, then hold on Cal hearing his name. Tiny radio hiss; no jump-scare volume spike.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal. Save me the window seat.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No. No, that is not—

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Cal? Your channel is open. Talk to me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I heard her. I know I heard her.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Set the brake. Tell me one thing you can see.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The receiver light. Amber. My hands are on the wheel.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I cannot keep it quiet much longer.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She told me never to call again.

scenes.title: Not an answer yet
scenes.stage: Camera follows Cal stepping outside only if chosen. A static alternative frames the parked cab for reduced motion. Road Force speaks from the roadside radio field; Grevyn's voice is not its imitation.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Those are her words. I carried them where a wire could not.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Who the hell are you?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Something the road was built across. Someone who needs you to listen.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That is a very practiced way of not answering.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Then do not trust me yet. Keep the recording. Ask your people to test it.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am recording you, too.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: If she is alive, why now?

scenes.title: A bearing through rock
scenes.stage: Three-second insert on receiver needle pointing toward a blocked ridge, then back to gameplay. Cal and TayJ mark uncertainty, not a magical destination pin. Riped arrives after the full recording is saved.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Old loop. It is a recording from before the collapse.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She said she cannot keep it quiet. That part was never in our calls.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You were hurt. You forget things.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Memory is why we kept the audio.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You do not have to forgive her to find out if she is alive.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I do not even know what I would say.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Start with what you know. Not what you owe her.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We check the source. That is all I am promising.

missions.title: Check the Source
missions.chapter: Chapter 1 - A Voice on the Road
missions.goal: Corroborate the voice through independent timing, a witness and a present-day facility signal.
steps: Compare recordings
Match the school phrase to the old call without treating voice similarity as proof of life.
Contact the relay witness
Drive to Orin's archive shelter and inspect recent monitored traffic.
Choose the search
Agree a route and crew contact plan.
object_hint: traffic_log
The new entry is under the receiver's current date stamp.
missions.choice: Cal may say he wants answers or wants to help; both begin the journey without forcing forgiveness.
missions.recovery: All proof is journaled in separate facts: genuine voice, current carrier, survival unconfirmed until corroborated.

scenes.title: The date on the carrier
scenes.stage: At the relay desk, dolly behind TayJ sorting paper logs for 4 seconds. Object-focus shot points to a current-date carrier stamp, not an automatic answer. Player aligns recordings with an accessible button alternative to waveform dragging.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: The words could be old. The carrier cannot. This relay restarted last winter.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: So someone sent it recently. Not necessarily her.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Exactly. We keep those as different claims.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You are all getting very excited over static.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And you are very certain for someone who has not listened.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I heard enough five years ago.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Play the complete log. No cuts.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That is how I kept it.

scenes.title: A teacher still asking
scenes.stage: Orin's single-storey archive shelter. Follow him slowly between filing shelves; his body remains in sight when he hands over a recent Trooper frequency list. Warm desk light separates him from cold exterior haze.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: The window-seat pair. I hoped you both got farther away than this.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Have you heard the name Grevyn on these channels?

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: A transfer reference. Three weeks ago. I did not know whether to believe it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: May I see the original?

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: That is the right question.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: A name is not a person. We should not waste supplies.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Then let the record disappoint us honestly. Do not edit it in advance.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Thank you.

scenes.title: A search with limits
scenes.stage: Crew route planning around the hood. A low, slow follow travels from Cal to TayJ's paper route. Camera returns before the player chooses his stated reason. No romantic framing in close-ups of Grevyn's photograph.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I need to know who lied. I am not promising a reunion.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: If she needs help, I want to try. That does not erase what she said.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Both can be true. You can care and still be hurt.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Scheduled contact at every relay. If a channel fails, we use the next marked stop.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I will ride with you. Somebody needs to keep this practical.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You follow the contact plan like everyone else.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Follow what can be checked. I will meet you where the signal ends.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And you can start answering questions there.

missions.title: Safe Passage
missions.chapter: Chapter 2 - The Cost of a Road
missions.goal: Repair a community crossing and escort a mixed convoy; earn trust through useful work.
steps: Survey the crossing
Walk the bank with Dain; mark the stable service ford.
Repair access
Move debris with a winch and fit two support plates.
Escort the convoy
Lead three vehicles through, then return a stranded driver's supplies.
object_hint: support_plate
The usable plate is beneath the blue tarp by the maintenance truck.
missions.choice: Donate a repair kit for faster access or collect salvage for a longer repair. Both remain viable and aid the settlement.
missions.recovery: Convoy vehicles stop before hazards; recover overturned essential cargo at the nearby yard. No fragile-NPC instant fail.

scenes.title: A road belongs to somebody
scenes.stage: Follow Dain and Cal along the bank with the convoy stationary behind them. Hold a wide shot showing the ford and flooded bridge together. A work-light glint suggests a support plate when the survey objective is active.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Bridge is finished. Ford is not, if we brace the bank.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: That convoy has families. I will not spend them on a shortcut.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Neither will I. We walk it first.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I could get across in second gear.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Excellent. We will tell the water how impressed we were.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I have a service yard two kilometers back. Plates, maybe a winch.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Tell the convoy we are waiting for a safe crossing, not for permission.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We can help build one.

scenes.title: Work before promises
scenes.stage: Gameplay labor. At the final brace placement, use a 5-second lateral tracking shot following Cal's handoff to Dain, showing safe rigging rather than a quick-time event. Do not play dialogue over loud winch effects.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: You were service once?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Gucki Troopers. I moved people without asking where they went.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Some of my people were moved.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I know saying sorry does not repair that.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Then do the work. And do not ask them to make you feel better.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will not.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Line is taking weight. Everybody behind the marker.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Convoy, hold position until the second brace is checked.

scenes.title: The last vehicle
scenes.stage: Camera follows the last convoy vehicle onto firm ground, then returns to Cal at the stalled driver. Success includes the driver's returned crate. No victory sting until the community vehicles have stopped safely.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: You kept your word about this crossing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: About this crossing. Yes.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Clinic received the first truck. Driver says you looked exhausted.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Informants everywhere.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Friends. Different department.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: My route saved at least an hour.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Dain's braces did. Your route was underwater.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Come by the yard. You earned a working jack, at least.

missions.title: The Price of Help
missions.chapter: Chapter 2 - The Cost of a Road
missions.goal: Negotiate passage without treating settlement residents as expendable; learn how faction support changes routes.
steps: Hear the demands
Meet Ness and the junction toll crew in daylight.
Choose a workable exchange
Deliver filters, repair the pump or pay from noncritical funds.
Reopen the shared road
Test the pump or verify payment and witness civilian passage.
object_hint: pump_valve
The pressure gauge beside the pump is stuck at zero.
missions.choice: Three valid solutions. Display costs before selection. Never silently consume medical supplies reserved for Grevyn.
missions.recovery: If funds are insufficient, the repair route stays available; a hostile response diverts to a longer safe road, not a softlock.

scenes.title: A hefty price
scenes.stage: At junction barriers, follow Cal stepping away from the truck with empty hands. Keep enforcers and exit visible in the wide shot. A small red lamp on the dry pump establishes the practical problem.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: The toll pays the pump crew. The pump feeds three stops.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And people without money?

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Wait. Sometimes too long.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Finally, a queue worse than government service.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Read the room.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: The pump might need a gasket, not a treasury.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Show us. Then we talk price.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Bring your own gauge. I would.

scenes.title: What can be spared
scenes.stage: Gameplay inspection, then player-facing itemized exchange screen. Camera may focus on the damaged gasket for 3 seconds after examination, never before entering the pump shelter. Choices use explicit quantity and travel-time previews.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Housing is sound. Seal is split. We can cut a replacement at the yard.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Not from a sterile pack. Those stay sealed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We use workshop rubber, or we pay. No borrowing from the clinic.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I marked the longer route, too. More fuel, fewer promises.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Everybody wants a committee meeting for a gasket.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Everybody wants water. That is why we are talking.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Tell me exactly what the repair buys for the people behind us.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Passage until next maintenance, posted in writing.

scenes.title: A posted agreement
scenes.stage: Follow Ness pinning the agreement to the barrier and opening it for a civilian vehicle before Cal's truck. If alternate route chosen, use radio confirmation instead; do not falsely show an unpaid toll opening.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Open it for them first.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: That is the agreement.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Gauge is holding. I left the spare seal with the crew.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Fuel stop marked. The shared road is still closed, so we tell the next convoy.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: A delay is survivable. Losing the medicine might not be.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we make the delay useful.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Some roads become safe because people make them so.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Try telling me something useful about Grevyn next.

missions.title: The Wrong Story
missions.chapter: Chapter 2 - The Cost of a Road
missions.goal: Collect conflicting accounts of Grevyn and separate firsthand sighting from propaganda.
steps: Interview witnesses
Hear Ness's supply contact, Dain's road account and a regime broadcast.
Compare dates
Pin each source to an independently verified convoy date.
Follow the consistent lead
Mark the government archive without declaring all rumors true.
object_hint: convoy_receipt
There is a date on the back, below the freight stamp.
missions.choice: Cal can challenge Riped now or hold questions. TayJ keeps discrepancies either way; no early forced villain reveal.
missions.recovery: Witness audio and receipts remain replayable. Hostile market encounter relocates interviews to the public radio booth.

scenes.title: A woman at the checkpoint
scenes.stage: Track Cal and Ness through the market at walking speed, no fast orbit. End on a freight receipt, after the witness account. Reused supporting performers must keep new roles distinct; here Ness recounts her own direct contact.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: A woman stopped their search. Said the driver was not the one they wanted.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Did she give a name?

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Grevyn. But I did not know her before that day.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Then it proves nothing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It proves she heard a name. Let her finish.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: The lights went out when the officer touched her. Every light, even the truck.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We write down exactly that. Not a miracle, not a diagnosis.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: And a date. Give me the receipt.

scenes.title: The face in the broadcast
scenes.stage: A public monitor shows Grevyn still, conditioned and calm beside regime insignia. Cut from Cal to the screen once, then hold for the full statement. Do not show supernatural possession as proof of voluntary loyalty.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Order is not what destroyed us. Abandoning it did. The Scatterballasian Regime will protect the roads again.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: Those who return have a place. Those who endanger our peace will answer for it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That does not sound like her.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: People change. Maybe you never knew her that well.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: You said she was dead. Now you know what she believes?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I am saying if it is her.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You did not say if.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We still need to know what happened to her.

scenes.title: Three dates
scenes.stage: At a quiet roadside table, move over the evidence board only after the player places receipts. The current-day broadcast and pre-collapse informant account cannot be merged into one date. TayJ preserves Riped's contradiction as a question.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: The supply convoy was last month. The public clip is newer. The prison report is five years old.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Different people can be describing the same person at different times.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And she can be alive without being safe.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Or the whole thing is bait.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It might be. That is why we check it.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: There is a report in the southern archive. It carries your name.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: What did you leave out this time?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Enough that you should read it yourself.

missions.title: His Name on the Page
missions.goal: Discover the denunciation attributed to Cal and recover the unedited protective request.
steps: Enter the archive
Use local access earned at the crossing or restore its public generator.
Find both versions
Compare the protective request carbon with the detention order.
Secure provenance
Record terminal timestamps, token use and document custody.
object_hint: request_carbon
The transfer ledger has a thin carbon page folded into its rear cover.
missions.choice: Tell Tay the shame immediately or ask for a private moment; evidence reaches both friends before the next chapter.
missions.recovery: Never destroy originals as a progression action. Scanned copies survive cargo loss with retrieval of originals optional for presentation.

scenes.title: A signature is not a history
scenes.stage: Slow follow behind Cal through archive aisle. A close shot reveals his service identity on the detention order only when he opens the folder. Hold his reaction without a dramatic camera shake.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That is my service number.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Read the rest before you decide what it means.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Witness Grevyn. Immediate detention. They used my name.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You signed a lot of things then. We all did.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I remember what I asked for.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then find the original request. Names can be copied. Context takes work.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Government records have margins. That is where people sometimes kept the truth.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Show me the carbon ledger.

scenes.title: Protective transport
scenes.stage: Object hint highlights the raised carbon edge only after Cal examines the ledger. A 4-second split composition frames protective pickup on one page and detention on the other. Player confirms three differences with a readable text option.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Protective pickup. No named witness. West service approach.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Now the copy they filed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Threat assessment. Named witness. Authorized detention. They changed the request.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Your signature was retained from the first form. The second carries a later transmission time.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Bad clerks. Half the state ran on bad clerks.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: That is not a spelling mistake.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No. It is somebody choosing words.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: Keep both pages. An accusation needs more than the page that hurts most.

scenes.title: Who had access
scenes.stage: Evidence desk. Follow Tay photographing the terminal custody sheet, then a short insert of the shared-session token number. No name is revealed as culprit yet: access is a lead, not conviction.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: The second message used your token after you left the depot.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I did not check it at the truck. She called. I just went.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Anybody could have used that desk.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Yes. So we find out who did.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You still signed earlier transfers. This does not make those disappear.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I know. But I did not hand her over.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We can hold both truths without dropping either one.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then that is what we do.

missions.title: What the Recording Says
missions.goal: Recover full radio traffic and expose the edits used to manufacture Cal's agreement to the arrest.
steps: Restore the relay recorder
Fit a replacement drive and recover the intact transport channel.
Compare three cuts
Match phrase boundaries, ambient noise and transmission time.
Preserve the raw stream
Make an offline duplicate and deliver one to the archive.
object_hint: raw_drive
The sealed drive is in the recorder base, below the empty cassette slot.
missions.choice: Confront the lie or ask Riped to explain technical access. He evades; no route allows him to delete earned proof.
missions.recovery: Accessible transcript comparison replaces audio puzzle. Lost drive can be recovered from archive mirror after first verification.

scenes.title: A convenient sentence
scenes.stage: Relay workbench, player-controlled repair. Once the drive spins, cut to a static medium shot of the crew listening. Edited speech is tagged as evidence playback in subtitles so actors do not perform it as a new confession.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: This is the filed excerpt. Notice the hiss change after hold.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They made me sound like I was giving an order.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Play what came before it.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: A damaged recorder skips. That is what damaged things do.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: A skip does not move a reply from one hour into another.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Let her finish.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Here is the full channel. We keep the noise between the words.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Go on.

scenes.title: A rescue note
scenes.stage: Insert the real handwritten note Cal retrieves from a civilian transport packet. The same words were attached to Grevyn's detention file. Follow Cal carrying both documents to the table; no floating text substitutes for a physical prop.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Hold her at the station until the vehicle arrives. This was a civilian with a broken hip.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: I treated her. You were asking them not to leave her on the platform.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: They removed the patient sheet and kept your handwriting.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They knew exactly how she would read it.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Or you are remembering the version you can live with.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: I was there.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: And the patient register was there. We are not voting on a memory.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Thank you for keeping it.

scenes.title: Not enough to name him
scenes.stage: Camera follows TayJ sealing an offline duplicate. A 3-second focus on the transfer hash and date reinforces provenance. Leave Cal and Riped in the same frame with physical distance growing between them.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You keep having an answer before we have a question.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I am trying to keep you from doing something stupid.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then help. Tell us who used the desk after I left.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: It was evacuation. People were everywhere.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I will put that down as you do not know.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Put down whatever you want. Apparently that is your job.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: I still want him to be our friend. That is not evidence either.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No. It is not.

missions.title: Where They Found Him
missions.goal: Return to the 2091 rescue site and assemble independently dated evidence of Cal's attempted return.
steps: Reach the old workshop
Retrieve Tay's treatment card and TayJ's rescue route record.
Survey the approaches
Inspect the destroyed crossing and marked blockade remains.
Build the chronology
Align injury, travel and intercepted-call times.
object_hint: treatment_box
Tay put the old treatment cards above the dry storage shelf.
missions.choice: Cal chooses whether to show the scar now; final reveal uses consent again. Scar alone never proves betrayal or attacker identity.
missions.recovery: No replayed injury damage. Trauma scenes allow static camera, subtitles and a pause without changing outcome.

scenes.title: The room they borrowed
scenes.stage: Track Cal entering the preserved workshop. Match the P04 rescue composition without a jump cut to the gunshot. Tay opens the treatment box only when asked. TayJ keeps the vehicle route chart within reach.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I remembered the ceiling lower.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You spent most of the week looking at it from that cot.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Rescue route, fuel receipt, transmission log. Original times, not reconstructed ones.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You really do keep everything.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I kept you. The paperwork came with it.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Treatment started twenty-one minutes after the blockade shots.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: After the time the report says I accepted evacuation payment.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You were bleeding on this floor then.

scenes.title: Both roads
scenes.stage: Wide follows at each route separately. Player inspects span damage and a service-road barrier mount. Ghostly memory overlays are optional, labelled subjective; objective journal evidence comes from documents and dated rescue travel, not visions.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Riped said this was quicker. It led nowhere.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We cannot prove he knew the crossing was down. We can prove you turned around.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: This is where we found you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I could hear the convoy. I thought if she heard me—

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You are here now. Feet on the road. Take the time you need.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I want to finish the record.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then we finish it together.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: What you tried was real, even when she could not see it.

scenes.title: A body is not the whole proof
scenes.stage: Sheltered table, static camera. Cal may uncover the healed scar briefly without sensational close-up, then cover it. Show the complete chronology next to it. The falsified payment entry is contradicted by a duplicated account number and recovery records.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: This is where it hit. I can show her. If she will let me speak.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: It proves you were shot. These records show when and where. We need both.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: And the payment never entered your account. They copied a cleared voucher number.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She believed I sold her for a seat out.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Someone worked hard to make that believable.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: We nearly done with the museum tour?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Now we ask who kept her alive afterward.

missions.title: Refuge
missions.goal: Find the former resistance shelter and learn how protection became coercion.
steps: Earn entry
Repair the shelter water line and meet Merrin under civilian oversight.
Find admission records
Locate Grevyn's voluntary refuge request and later confinement order.
Open the laboratory wing
Restore a manual door mechanism and preserve its contents.
object_hint: intake_folder
The intake card is filed under arrivals, not detainees.
missions.choice: Offer Merrin public testimony protection or insist on supervised custody; neither absolves her or destroys her research.
missions.recovery: Evidence is mandatory and cannot be traded for passage. Locked-wing bypass remains available if Merrin refuses cooperation.

scenes.title: They promised protection
scenes.stage: Track Merrin leading Cal through the shelter's communal room, 6 seconds; pass an old resistance banner repurposed as a curtain. End at a locked clinic door. Civilians continue ordinary activity rather than staring as a hostile crowd.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: She came here because we said nobody would be handed back.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Did you keep that promise?

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: Not the promise she thought we made.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then explain what you did keep.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: The doors closed. Supplies stopped. Our leaders started calling people assets.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Desperate times. We have all heard the story.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We have not heard this one. Stop finishing it for her.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Start with the day Grevyn arrived.

scenes.title: A change of category
scenes.stage: Player reads Grevyn's refuge application beside a later restricted-subject order. Camera hints at mismatched staples after the first examination. The documents explicitly separate resistance origin, corruption and subsequent regime partnership.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: We had fought the regime. That part was real.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then you took its equipment. Its methods.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: And told ourselves the purpose made them different.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Did she consent to the exposure?

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Say the whole thing.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: We promised protection, confined her and exposed her without consent.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That statement goes with the signed order.

scenes.title: A voice in the margin
scenes.stage: Laboratory entrance. Follow Cal opening the manual shutter; focus for 3 seconds on tiny handwriting behind a maintenance label. Do not reveal the formula yet. Road Force avoids answering a question; Cal notices.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: If I forget what this is for, read the blue pages first.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: She was leaving instructions for herself.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: And for whoever reached her afterward.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You know this room.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I know what happened here.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Those are different things.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: You brought the road with you.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We are going to need more batteries. And better answers.

missions.title: Treatment
missions.goal: Discover Gucki Paste's three linked functions and why sudden deprivation would endanger Grevyn.
steps: Audit the dosing station
Read administration logs without dispensing anything to a person.
Recover observation films
Compare lucidity, instability and physical decline across dated sessions.
Plan a substitute
Mark the medical support system and locate a stabilizer research reference.
object_hint: dose_log
Three columns repeat on every page: body, field and compliance.
missions.choice: Acknowledge that withholding Paste is not a rescue plan. No option administers or withholds real treatment by guesswork.
missions.recovery: All research is fictional. Puzzle uses inventory seals and document ordering, not a real chemical recipe.

scenes.title: Three things at once
scenes.stage: Follow Tay through the dosing bay. Close focus on three labelled channels in a fictional apparatus: somatic support, field regulation, compliance. Avoid syringes in close-up; environmental restraint marks convey abuse without spectacle.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: It is keeping her body going. That does not make it medicine she chose.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And it feeds whatever is controlling her.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: It regulates the field, sustains damaged tissue and reinforces the connection.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: So take it away. Problem solved.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Her organs fail. The field becomes unstable. She may get lucid and die knowing it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They built a fucking leash out of keeping her alive.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then we find a way to support her without the leash.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: That is the problem we solve.

scenes.title: The lucid interval
scenes.stage: Projection of Grevyn's own lab recording, visibly dated. Frame the screen in a neutral room, not as an apparition. Her speech is exhausted but exact. Cut to the player-controlled notebook after the entire recording.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Reduced dose. I know my own name again. I also cannot keep my hands warm.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: The power has not vanished. It is coming loose. That is not the same thing as freedom.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: There must be support without reinforcement. I have started a separate formula.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: We confiscated it. She started again.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Of course she did.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Where is the second set?

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: I never found it. I thought she had given up.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You did not know her very well.

scenes.title: Do not make it a countdown
scenes.stage: At the workbench, Tay marks unknowns on a fictional treatment chart. The guide for players explicitly says exploration is not running down an unseen biological timer. Road Force confirms residual energy can still threaten them.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Are we wasting time every minute we stand here?

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We do not know her current dose. Panic will not replace a plan.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We follow the next lead. We do not pretend the road is a stopwatch.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Weakening the connection will not empty what has already gathered around her.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then tell us how to separate it safely.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Not here. Not without something that keeps her alive.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We find her formula first.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we finish what she started.

missions.title: Something She Hid
missions.goal: Recover Grevyn's first hidden Golghis research and her testimony during lucid captivity.
steps: Read the maintenance trail
Match three harmless-seeming repair requests to room positions.
Open the false shelf
Use Grevyn's map-cabinet habit to find her notebook compartment.
Recover her voice
Play her warning and preserve the notebook separately from its copy.
object_hint: false_shelf
The shelf depth changes beneath the blue maintenance mark.
missions.choice: Cal can hear a personal note now or later. The clinical findings are mandatory and her intimate recording is never public currency.
missions.recovery: No memory trivia lock: the prologue journal recalls the cabinet method. All clue objects remain available after discovery.

scenes.title: Repairs she did not need
scenes.stage: Track Cal counting shelf bays while TayJ reads maintenance requests over radio. At the false shelf, use a 3-second oblique view revealing a depth mismatch. The hint activates only after two legitimate searches.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Three requests for a broken hinge. The hinge was replaced every time.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She wanted people looking at the front.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Like the map cabinet.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She hated a hiding place that looked clever.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Or it is just a badly built shelf.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we check it, and it is a badly built shelf.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: A very scientific method.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: There. Blue paper.

scenes.title: For whoever finds this
scenes.stage: Notebook found. Static medium shot while Grevyn's recorded voice plays; do not animate a hallucinated Grevyn speaking to Cal. Her research owns the scene. Object close-up shows the name Golghis, not an invented real medical formula.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Golghis. A stupid name on purpose. Something that was mine before they numbered it.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: The substitute supports the damage without feeding the bond. It does not heal everything.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Do not use the first draft. Two pages are wrong because I wrote them while it was speaking through me.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I marked the corrected sequence with the school map. West, not north.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You left yourself a way back.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We are going to use her corrections, not make her into a miracle.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: A notebook is not a cure.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No. It is a start she made while you thought she was dead.

scenes.title: A note he can leave closed
scenes.stage: Player choice before personal recording. If declined, it stays in private journal for later. Camera stays at respectful distance; no forced tears. The research copy is sealed before departure.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I do not know whether I hate you, Cal, or whether hating you is one of the things they kept giving me.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I remember you not coming. I remember a version where I heard you outside. I cannot make them fit.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: If you are real when I see you, let me finish a sentence before you leave.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I was trying to finish mine.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You do not have to answer her today.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Clinical pages copied. Private recording stays private.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Good. Next lead.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: She kept more of herself than they understood.

missions.title: Golghis
missions.goal: Establish the viable treatment path and a transparent rescue preparation checklist.
steps: Reconstruct the index
Separate lucid corrections from compromised notebook pages.
Consult the specialist trail
Identify Dr. Sable Nadir's annotations and captivity location.
Make a rescue ledger
List missing pages, support medium, sealed carrier and catalyst activation.
object_hint: corrected_index
The west-facing map symbol marks Grevyn's corrected pages.
missions.choice: Commit to the full investigation or mark a provisional faster route. Both remain reversible until final consent.
missions.recovery: Checklist always shows known, missing and replaceable components. It does not call incomplete Paste safe.

scenes.title: A plan with missing pieces
scenes.stage: At a workshop board, follow Cal pinning Grevyn's handwritten index beside Tay's support chart. Player sorts page symbols; accessible list selection does the same task. Camera never auto-solves the order.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: She solved the principle. We still need the support medium and someone who can check the process.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The notes in the margins. Different hand?

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Dr. Sable Nadir. One transfer log says she was moved to holding twelve.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Great. Another prisoner. We can rescue the whole country while we are at it.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Sable is a person, not a delay.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And we do not make Grevyn drink a guess.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Tell me what needs transporting. I will build a cradle that keeps it level.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am making a checklist we can all read.

scenes.title: What preparation buys
scenes.stage: UI checklist comes after the spoken explanation. Each item has an explicit effect: complete formula, verified support, activated catalyst, working containment, enough force reserve or replacement capacitors. No percentage promise yet.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: With verified Golghis, her body gets support while the bond weakens. That gives us a planned severing.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Without it, what I tear away may take her with it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And with it?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: You still need the equipment and her consent when she can give it. I cannot replace either.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Missing now does not mean missing forever. We marked the recovery stops.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Or we go straight there before everybody dies of planning.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Rushing blind nearly got me killed once.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then we know what to do differently.

scenes.title: Who gets to decide
scenes.stage: Crew discussion at camp. Follow Tay stepping away to her own clinic radio call before returning, showing her life beyond Cal. Cal may disagree without relationship-score punishment. Save the chosen plan as intent, not outcome.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We follow her work. Every page we can recover.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We investigate on the way, but I want a shorter route marked too.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Marked. You can change it at the next relay.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And when we reach her, we explain it to her. We do not take over because we came to help.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Yes. No more deciding she is an asset.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Heroic. Very moving. Can we eat now?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: After you help Dain unload. You volunteered to be practical.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: I wrote it down.

missions.title: The Missing Work
missions.chapter: Chapter 5 - A Way to Keep Her Here
missions.goal: Recover Grevyn's corrected research from a mobile laboratory route.
steps: Trace the field lab
Follow dated service receipts to a deserted mobile-lab bay.
Recover three corrections
Search the desk, cold store and maintenance locker using the index.
Verify the sequence
Send page identifiers to Tay and preserve the redacted experiment victims list.
object_hint: maintenance_locker
The locker label uses the same west-facing map symbol.
missions.choice: Release victim names privately to families or retain them with an independent archive; never broadcast them over open radio.
missions.recovery: Each research page is separately journaled. Missing cargo can be replaced from the verified scan at the relay.

scenes.title: A lab on wheels
scenes.stage: Follow Cal alongside the abandoned trailer, avoiding its blocked front door; a wide shot shows a viable side entrance. Small reflection on a service receipt suggests the trail without a giant beam through walls.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Trailer axle is broken. Somebody stripped the wheels, not the cabinets.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: This is the unit on her index.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Excellent. Deserted medical equipment. My favorite holiday.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Three storage positions. Do not assume the first page is the last draft.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I was in history class, remember?

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: You slept through the footnotes.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn did not let me.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Neither will I. Gloves before that locker.

scenes.title: The corrected sequence
scenes.stage: After collection, player aligns page identifiers with Grevyn's audio. Camera pushes only to the crossed-out field, not a readable real chemical process. Warnings distinguish deliberately false notes from her recovered corrections.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: If the field meter rises when the support starts, stop. You have copied their version.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: The corrected carrier holds the body steady while the bond drops. There are three checks. Keep all three.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We have the corrections. You can read her own checks beside them.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Good. That is a treatment protocol we can verify, not hope with a label.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Could have got the same information at the main facility.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: How do you know what is still in the main facility?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Because it is the main one. Obviously.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am keeping that answer too.

scenes.title: Names are people
scenes.stage: Cal finds victim records tucked with the corrections. Hold a quiet static shot, no collectible jingle. The choice concerns protected custody, not whether to keep evidence. Dain begins constructing the cargo cradle nearby.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They numbered them. She wrote the names back in.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then we keep them protected. Families should not learn this from a public frequency.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: My brother disappeared on a transfer. Could I check privately?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Yes. Take your time.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Looks like we are taking all the time.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Not this time, Riped.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Victim ledger goes in the private case. Formula copy goes to you.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Separate channels. Separate copies. Understood.

missions.title: Someone Who Can Read It
missions.chapter: Chapter 5 - A Way to Keep Her Here
missions.goal: Find Sable's current detention route and secure help without trading away other prisoners.
steps: Visit the transfer market
Compare three route slips with Ness's supply ledger.
Trace the convoy
Follow abandoned tire marks to the holding-facility service district.
Arrange extraction
Prepare a clinic vehicle and an independent civilian evacuation line.
object_hint: transfer_slip
Look for Sable's clinic code beneath the freight number, not her full name.
missions.choice: Assist displaced civilians for a safer extraction route or repair the service bypass for a quieter one. Both can be completed.
missions.recovery: The prison visit occurs later in M18-M21. This mission provides intelligence, not a fake rescue already completed.

scenes.title: A route is not a warrant
scenes.stage: Public records stall. Track Ness bringing Cal a supply ledger; keep refugees in the scene as autonomous people. Player must compare dates before a route pin appears.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: I can show you deliveries. I cannot promise who is still inside.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That is enough to start.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Sable's clinic code appears twice. One line is an old route.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: North holding. Always north holding.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: When were you last there?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You learn these things. I keep my ears open.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: South deliveries increased last week. Read the dates.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We will.

scenes.title: An extraction for more than one
scenes.stage: At the service district overlook, camera follows Dain positioning the clinic van behind cover, then returns before player selects a bypass. No hostile base map reveals unexplored interior rooms.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: I can fit a stretcher and four seats if we remove the rear bench.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Leave space for people we do not know yet.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We do not walk past a prisoner because their name was not on our plan.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: That is how you end up with no plan.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: No. That is why we brought a second vehicle.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: My people can take civilians at the crossing if you get them out.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Tell me which road to clear.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Both, if we can. Quiet first, obvious if it goes wrong.

scenes.title: A voice on a test channel
scenes.stage: Sable's short intercepted message confirms survival and a medical transfer list. Speaker is offscreen, physically elsewhere. Camera stays on the receiver and Cal's notes, no impossible cut to a place the crew has not seen.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: This is Nadir. I am not authorizing any field transfer. These people need monitoring.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Your authorization is no longer required.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Then stop putting my name on it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They do not get very original, do they?

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: She is alive. We keep the plan careful.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: And we do not answer on that channel. They may be listening for help.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: See? We should go straight in.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: After supplies. After the way out is ready.

missions.title: Cargo Worth Taking
missions.chapter: Chapter 5 - A Way to Keep Her Here
missions.goal: Collect fictional sealed medical support components and transport them without harming local care.
steps: Source the components
Obtain a sealed support cartridge, inert carrier gel and insulated transport case.
Earn replacements
Restore a community refrigeration unit or make a reciprocal supply run.
Protect the shipment
Secure the cradle, cool it at two checkpoints and deliver to the workshop.
object_hint: case_latches
The case is not secured until both orange cradle straps are fastened.
missions.choice: Raid abandoned stock or earn clinic surplus; taking clinic essentials is explicitly blocked. Cargo damage opens replacement work.
missions.recovery: Temperature uses leg-based checks, not a hidden real-time timer while paused or exploring. Guaranteed replacement mission remains before M35.

scenes.title: Not their last box
scenes.stage: Clinic store, warm daylight and a working fan. Follow Tay examining seals while Cal reads the stock card. No threatening music for a supply negotiation.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We need the support cartridge, but not if this is your last one.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: It is the last ready one. Fix the cold room and I can release the next batch.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: We could just take the box and be gone.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: That answer is worth more than your old badge.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Compressor mount first. Then the belt. We can do it.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I found the service manual. It even has pictures for Riped.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Hilarious.

scenes.title: The cradle
scenes.stage: Playable repair and loading. A 4-second tracking insert follows the case into Dain's cradle, ending on two unfastened straps as an interaction hint. Camera releases before fastening; no auto-completion.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Weight low. Lid toward the cab. Both straps, not one.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: If the cooling light changes?

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Pull into the marked shade stop. Do not open the sterile compartment.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Two cooling stops on the route. No surprise timer while you are reading the map.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I could carry it on my knees.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: And I could bill your knees for the replacement. Use the cradle.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Seals intact. We can move.

scenes.title: A choice that is visible
scenes.stage: At a threatened supply detour, slow the action into an explicit route decision before any cargo loss. Show resource preview and replacement location. The player can protect cargo, rescue stranded civilians with a detour, or do both with extra work.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Stranded vehicle ahead. We have room, but the short road crosses broken ground.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Long way costs fuel, not the case?

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Correct. I checked the roadbed.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: If the case is compromised, we replace it. We do not pretend the risk went away.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Or we keep driving and stop adopting people.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They can hear you.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: I have replacement stock coming. Bring the people if you can.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Show me both routes. We choose knowing the cost.

missions.title: The Warning
missions.chapter: Chapter 5 - A Way to Keep Her Here
missions.goal: Learn the cost of the road force's help and prepare for a government-building evidence search.
steps: Reach the ridge relay
Repair a passive repeater instead of requesting an immediate intervention.
Test the warning
Observe a small controlled physical intervention and its measurable depletion.
Plan the archive entry
Agree check-ins, exit signals and a missing-contact response.
object_hint: passive_repeater
The relay can carry the message if its ground cable is reconnected.
missions.choice: Ask for physical help or do the repair; the cost is shown first. Restoration options later prevent a hidden early-choice bad ending.
missions.recovery: No intervention spends unconfirmed reserve. A minimum narrative display can be free; physical work costs persistent reserve.

scenes.title: Something moves
scenes.stage: At a ridge maintenance hut, follow Cal to a fallen gate. Road Force offers to lift it; the player may repair the winch instead. Its spectral field is sparse amber dust following road seams, distinct from Dominion's cold electrical geometry.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can move the gate. It will leave less of me for what comes later.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: How much less?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: One measure of what I have left. Your receiver can show it.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am putting the change on the meter. Before and after.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Or repair the winch. Forty minutes of work beats an unexplained miracle.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not get to spend yourself without telling us the price.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Very moving. Even the ghost gets a budget.

scenes.title: What it will not say
scenes.stage: Static shot of the receiver's depleted or preserved field display. Road Force acknowledges the need for equipment but withholds its past involvement; stage a short silence and let Cal react. No fake objective suggests its whole story is known.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Were you there when they first exposed her?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Were you trying to stop it?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I tried. I was not strong enough.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That does not tell us how it started.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: The first prison does. I will take you there before you must choose.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You keep deciding what we get to know.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes. I have.

scenes.title: Check in before going in
scenes.stage: At camp, follow TayJ handing Cal a paired recorder while Tay checks his old injury. Riped watches the exit code being agreed. Cal and Riped will search the archive while Tay and TayJ maintain the outside contact route.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Miss one check-in, we call. Miss two, we use the service entrance. No heroic guessing.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And if the old wound pulls, you say so before it changes your footing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: You have me. Nothing happens without me noticing.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then notice the second transmitter and leave it switched on.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We get the records. We do not split up.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Would not dream of it.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: The building is not empty.

missions.title: Abandoned
missions.goal: Search an allegedly abandoned government building with Riped and suffer a staged ambush.
steps: Search the public offices
Recover a current transfer index and signs of recent occupation.
Reach the secure wing
Open a manual archive gate after a warning about active defenses.
Survive the ambush
Retreat toward cover; scripted capture follows without pretending it was avoidable.
object_hint: warm_terminal
The terminal fan is running beneath the dusty counter.
missions.choice: Stealth or cautious entry changes recovered supplies. This is a clearly staged capture sequence, not punishment for choosing the wrong route.
missions.recovery: Save before entry and after capture. Preserve all evidence in journal; confiscated physical gear is recoverable in M20.

scenes.title: Dust with footprints
scenes.stage: Follow Cal and Riped through the lobby, 6 seconds, framing fresh boot marks crossing dust. A 3-second focus on the running terminal fan hints that the building is occupied. Player can retreat to check equipment before committing.

lines.speaker: CAL
