lines.text: Somebody has been through here today.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Scavengers. Do not jump at every footprint.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Your building is drawing power. Not much, but it is current.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We stay together.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Obviously. Records are this way.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You sound sure.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: It says archive on the wall, Cal.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Second transmitter is fading. Check the cable before the wing.

scenes.title: The living index
scenes.stage: Secure archive. Player photographs a present-day Grevyn transfer record and Grandpa's conditioning authorization. A camera follow tracks Cal returning toward the exit, not deeper into an invisible trigger. Door movement and footfalls warn of the ambush.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Current transfer. Subject retained for reconstruction command.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Take the page and move.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grandpa Gucki signed the authorization himself.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Set the record down, Reed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You knew we were coming.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Hands visible. Nobody needs to demonstrate courage.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: What the hell is this?

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Cal, answer. Cal—

scenes.title: Capture
scenes.stage: Gameplay offers a short, survivable retreat to cover; capture is the authored endpoint. Voss orders nonlethal restraint. Cut from Cal reaching a blocked exit to an intake table with a clear time transition. Do not force a long unwinnable shootout.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Back door. Stay behind me.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: It is locked!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Alive. The commander wants the witness alive.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not get to call her that again.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You may explain your preferences in intake.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: We came for abandoned records. That is all.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Tell them nothing.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Your friend understands the procedure.

missions.title: Intake
missions.goal: Observe detention routines, retain evidence and start an escape without knowing Riped was released.
steps: Learn the routine
Inspect cell, service hatch and guard-change sounds.
Contact Riped
Speak through the wall before his covert removal.
Reach the service corridor
Use a maintenance access during a power interruption.
object_hint: service_hatch
Cool air comes through the lower maintenance grille.
missions.choice: Cal can request Road Force help after seeing its cost or use the mechanical route. Both keep a later recovery path.
missions.recovery: No real-time solitary wait. Interactions advance routines. Captured evidence is copied, not deleted; later item restitution is idempotent.

scenes.title: Two cells
scenes.stage: Camera follows Cal into a ground-level cell, never through locked walls. Riped is heard in an adjacent cell. A tray scrape and distant transformer identify the mechanical escape route. No audience-only release scene yet.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You will be asked about the archive. You will answer the question asked.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I have heard that speech. I helped you make people listen to it.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then you know its value.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Cal! I told them this is a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Stop telling them things.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I am trying to get us out.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Wait for a chance. I am not leaving you in here.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Right. Of course.

scenes.title: A quieter offer
scenes.stage: Receiver recovered from a gap in intake wiring carries the Road Force. Player can instead use a metal bed fastener to open the grille. The camera hints at moving dust near the vent only after Cal examines airflow.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can break the latch. It will cost another measure.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You said we would need you at the end.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: You will. There is also a service fastener beneath the bed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: An actual useful answer. Keep doing that.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Two knocks if you hear. Do not answer by voice.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: TayJ.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Alive is enough. We are working on the rest.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: So am I.

scenes.title: The corridor
scenes.stage: After the hatch opens, track Cal crouching into the service corridor for 5 seconds, ending before a junction decision. An empty stretcher and disconnected camera lead toward confiscated property. Far off, a controlled blast masks Riped's staged cell breach.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Property room first. Then Riped.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: If you are a guard, you have taken a very strange route.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Dr. Nadir?

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: That depends who is asking.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Callum Reed. We found Grevyn's research. I need help getting her out.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Then do not touch the dosing cabinet. Start with my door.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am coming back for you.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Say where and when. People say back very easily in here.

missions.title: The Hole in the Wall
missions.goal: Recover gear and find Riped's apparently blasted-open cell, mistaking a staged release for escape.
steps: Recover confiscated items
Open property storage and reconcile every essential item.
Reach Riped's cell
Inspect the empty room and outward-blown wall.
Commit to extraction
Leave a rendezvous mark and return for Sable and the other prisoners.
object_hint: riped_cell
Dust on the floor changes near the service wing; follow the numbered cell signs.
missions.choice: Cal may notice the unusual blast but lacks enough proof yet. He reasonably assumes Riped escaped; do not make him ignore obvious evidence.
missions.recovery: Essential inventory ledger restores each item once. Cell evidence can be revisited in final disclosure; no hidden inspection requirement for a good ending.

scenes.title: Everything they took
scenes.stage: Follow Cal opening the property cage, then insert the stamped seizure list beside his kit. Player checks essential cargo and recorder. Archived scans remain intact even if a noncritical item is absent.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Recorder. Journal. Medical case. They logged everything except a conscience.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Cal? Short answers. Where are you?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Property storage. Alive. Sable is here. Riped is next.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Service exit south. Dain has the van. Tay is preparing seats.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Any signal from Riped?

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Nothing on the agreed channel.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then I find him.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: And come back. That part stays in the plan.

scenes.title: An exit made for one
scenes.stage: Camera follows Cal to Riped's cell, 5 seconds; widen to reveal the broken wall. No suspicious dossier conveniently explains everything. Blast residue and undamaged latch can be examined but are marked ambiguous until later release documents.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Riped?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: He got out. Bastard actually got out.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: A wall was opened. That is all I can tell you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.direction: trying to trust the practical reading
lines.text: He must have found charges in the service wing.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Maybe. Take a picture. Keep the questions for daylight.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Latch is still intact. Could have been the only way.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We do not have his route. We do have people waiting for yours.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will leave the rendezvous mark. Then Sable.

scenes.title: Not waiting for a ghost
scenes.stage: Cal places the crew's rendezvous strip outside the breach; camera follows his hand back to the escape corridor, returning control before enemy patrols resume. No objective suggests Riped actually died or genuinely escaped.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Riped, south service road. We have a van. Use the second channel.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We have room. Bring whoever can walk, we will help the rest.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: I heard a blast. Are they opening cells or destroying records?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I do not know yet.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Good. Keep saying that when it is true.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I promised to come back. Here I am.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Then help me with this lock.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: This time someone can see you returned.

missions.title: Bring Someone With You
missions.goal: Free Sable and other detainees, evacuate with the crew and discover enough release evidence to suspect Riped.
steps: Free the clinic wing
Open the service locks and move injured detainees to cover.
Reach the extraction
Use either prepared road; escort without fragile-NPC fail states.
Treat and debrief
Stabilize escapees, verify research and decode a partial release entry.
object_hint: lock_feed
The clinic locks share the labelled service breaker, separate from life support.
missions.choice: Quiet release or public diversion affects pursuit pressure. Both save all reachable captives; no reward for abandoning an injured prisoner.
missions.recovery: Downed allies receive assisted movement; rescue checkpoint preserves evacuee count. Replacements for lost Paste supplies are offered explicitly.

scenes.title: Not an experiment
scenes.stage: Follow Sable leaving her room at normal speed, stopping to assist another detainee. Player disconnects only labelled lock power. A shot along the corridor shows both cover and the service exit before pursuit starts.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: That switch runs the monitors. The lower one runs the locks. Do not guess.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Lower breaker. Locks only.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Good. We are not proving a point with someone else's pulse.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Tell me injuries before you move them.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Two walking, one needs support. One cannot bear weight.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Dain is bringing the stretcher. Stay behind the concrete divider.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Service road open. We have your signal.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Nobody here has to earn their seat.

scenes.title: The van
scenes.stage: Track the stretcher from behind at walking pace for 6 seconds while Dain and Tay load it. No camera hijack during active fire: this shot begins only after the doors and smoke screen secure the loading bay. Gameplay then controls the escape drive.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Brake on. Doors wide. Watch the step.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You sit for the first stretch. Your hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I can drive.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You can. You do not have to.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: I can monitor from the rear. I am a doctor when nobody is holding a gun to the chart.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then tell me what you need.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: First checkpoint cleared. Riped still is not answering.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Keep trying. Keep the log.

scenes.title: A release, not a breach
scenes.stage: Safe clinic debrief. A partially recovered release ledger marks Riped's cell cleared before the blast; not yet a full confession. Camera focuses on the two timestamps only after decoding. Sable recognizes Grevyn's corrections and supports a real plan.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: His cell was cleared before the wall came down. The authorization field is damaged.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: They moved him first. Or he got the guard to log an escape early.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Both possible. Neither matches what we saw.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: These corrections are hers. She tried to keep a version they could not make her destroy.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Can you finish it?

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: With verified stock and an activated catalyst, yes. It will support her, not undo years in a night.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then we give her the best chance we can prepare.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And we find out who opened his cell.

missions.title: The Catalyst
missions.goal: Retrieve a fictional field catalyst from a contaminated road research station.
steps: Survey the station
Read the hazard chart and isolate a safe path using portable sensors.
Recover the inert core
Disable two field relays, then transport the catalyst in its shielded case.
Exit without exposure
Navigate a displaced-road anomaly with TayJ's physical landmarks.
object_hint: inert_core
Only the socket with the unlit outer ring is safe to open.
missions.choice: Restore a passive bypass or request a priced Road Force intervention. Grevyn's survival never depends on an unannounced early test.
missions.recovery: Anomaly resets move the truck to the last stable turnout, preserving cargo. No flashing navigation dependency; labels and tones duplicate color.

scenes.title: Roads that disagree
scenes.stage: Track the crew stopping before an impossible road split. The wide shot shows one physical barrier and two inconsistent horizons. On-foot sensors reveal stable ground; the camera never points the player into an active lethal zone.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Ignore the horizon for a moment. Read the posts. Three close, one broken.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I drove past the broken one twice.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: The field folds what you expect to see. The posts are still where people put them.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We use measurements, not a feeling of certainty.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: I marked the truck position with a cable. Follow it back if the road moves.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Posts. Cable. Receiver. Things we can check.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And us. You can still hear us.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I can.

scenes.title: An inert piece of a bargain
scenes.stage: Follow Cal carrying the shielded case from station entrance to workbench at 1 m/s; insert the unlit ring only after he reads the socket instructions. The catalyst is invented supernatural material, never described as a real extract or chemical.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: It is inert here. It needs the Road Force's field to take the corrected structure.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: So we cannot just find another one later?

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We can replace the housing. This core is the one verified in Grevyn's work.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can activate it. That will cost more than moving a gate.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You tell us the cost before we do it.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: At the ridge station. With your meter watching.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Core number matches. Closing the ledger entry, not the case until you say.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Case latched. Both handles. Moving.

scenes.title: The way back is marked
scenes.stage: A short rear vehicle follow shows Dain's cable and marker posts, then returns full drive control. Optional rescue of trapped scavengers costs route time only; passive repair earns a stored capacitor that can later replace depleted reserve.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Your rear wheels are clear. Slow left past the broken post.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Which left? The road has developed opinions.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Your left. I have not issued the road voting rights.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: The station crew are at the fence. We can bring them to the crossing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Mark the stable path for them. Nobody follows an illusion out.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Grevyn wrote that, too. Leave a route someone else can use.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She used to hate when people erased their workings.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Then keep yours.

missions.title: What the Road Gives
missions.goal: Activate the catalyst with informed consent and establish concrete reserve recovery options.
steps: Prepare the test rig
Install a receiver, shield and field meter.
Authorize activation
See the reserve cost, then activate or first rebuild capacitor support.
Store the result
Verify field polarity, seal the core and record the remaining reserve.
object_hint: field_meter
The meter is connected only when both labelled leads are seated.
missions.choice: Activation costs two reserve units. Optional capacitors add equivalent severing capacity, not life to the Road Force. Restore enough before final consent.
missions.recovery: The essential catalyst cannot be permanently destroyed. Failed housing checks return it inert for a safe repeat without double-charging reserve.

scenes.title: Before the meter moves
scenes.stage: Ridge workbench at dusk. Track TayJ fitting the meter, then hold a wide showing Road Force's amber field separate from the blue sealed catalyst. Player sees the exact cost panel before choosing.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Meter stable. Receiver isolated from the vehicle battery.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Activation takes two measures. I have no way to take them back.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Can the prison equipment make up the difference later?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Its stored field can help the severing. It cannot make me whole.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Then we record both. Your strength and the equipment's capacity are different supplies.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We can rebuild the capacitors first if you want the safer margin.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No surprises after I say yes.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: None about this cost.

scenes.title: Activation
scenes.stage: Six-second still-wide transformation, then 4-second close view of catalyst bands stabilizing. Amber filaments pass into the core; receiver reserve falls by exactly two once success commits. Reduced-flash option substitutes steady illumination and a low tone.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Keep the corrected pattern steady. Not the old one.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Corrected pattern locked. Body support isolated.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Reserve falling. One measure. Two. Holding.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Stop if it keeps falling.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: It has stopped.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Everybody breathe. Nobody touch the hot housing.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Activated. We can finish the substitute.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You sound farther away.

scenes.title: A debt made visible
scenes.stage: Follow Cal putting the catalyst into the secured cradle. If reserve is below final threshold, TayJ points to an explicit capacitor rebuild task before travel resumes. No invented successful asset or audio claim: these are screenplay cues for future production.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I am less here than I was.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You could have said that without making it sound like a riddle.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: You are right.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Two prison capacitors will restore the working margin. I marked the salvage stops.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We do not count the substitute finished until we test the full support sequence.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we test it. And we go to your first prison.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: There is something there I should have told you already.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Yes. I think there is.

missions.title: Finish Her Work
missions.goal: Prepare verified Golghis Paste and give explicit opportunities to replace anything lost or skipped.
steps: Audit missing work
Compare corrections, stock seals, catalyst and specialist review in a four-part ledger.
Recover gaps
Complete any missing-page, replacement-stock or capacitor salvage tasks.
Prepare and verify
Let Sable and Tay run Grevyn's fictional three-check process and seal doses.
object_hint: verification_tray
The blank verification cards are beside Grevyn's corrected index.
missions.choice: A planned batch requires all checks. An incomplete batch is labelled emergency-only, with a later final repair opportunity.
missions.recovery: No irreversible commit here. Missing Sable is resolved by returning to the service route; in this linear story her rescue is mandatory.

scenes.title: Everything on the bench
scenes.stage: Slow lateral follow along supplies to Grevyn's notebook, ending on the empty verification cards. UI explicitly lists each missing prerequisite and exact recovery objective. No vague readiness percentage.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Corrected sequence. Verified support. Activated catalyst. Clean sealed carrier.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: I have the body-support chart and a second observer for each check.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: What are we missing?

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Nothing essential. We can prepare the planned batch.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: The ledger marks the gaps. We can repair them before we ask her to risk this.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Every marked replacement stop has a route and enough fuel to reach it.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Truck is not leaving because somebody gets impatient.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Show me the list.

scenes.title: Golghis
scenes.stage: Preparation montage follows hands, labels and verification lights, not a real actionable recipe. Three brief inserts are separated by playable equipment checks. Grevyn's recorded words guide the work. The music is warm but unresolved.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: First check is support without field reinforcement. Do not let a quiet room fool you.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Support holding. Field not rising.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Second is separation under load. Third is recovery. Write down failures. Especially the ones you want to ignore.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Recovery within her corrected range.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We are writing it down.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Verified batch. It is ready for monitored use.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Provisional only. It is not safe to call this the planned treatment.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The label says what it is. No better story than the facts.

scenes.title: Not a cure for everything
scenes.stage: After the batch is sealed, follow Cal taking a meal with the crew. He may ask to sit with Tay, call TayJ or rest alone with a scheduled check-in. These are characterization choices, not an approval test.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: When this is done, is she going to be herself?

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: She is herself now, under coercion and injury. Recovery is not returning a machine to factory settings.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And she might not want the same life you remember.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Neither do I, some days.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We can still want a next day.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Start with the next hour. Soup. Then sleep.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You are all getting very good at ordering me around.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Only when you outsource basic maintenance.

missions.title: The First Prison
missions.goal: Survey the original Road Force containment site and prepare it for voluntary severing instead of imprisonment.
steps: Reach the site
Drive the service access and verify a stable medical vehicle route.
Survey the equipment
Inspect three field clamps, the manual bypass and accessible treatment platform.
Make it usable
Repair floor access, lighting and reserve capacitor mounts.
object_hint: manual_bypass
The release wheel is painted on both sides; it was built to turn from inside as well.
missions.choice: Dismantle coercive locks while retaining field guidance. Never present rebuilding a prison as morally neutral treatment.
missions.recovery: Site geometry is single-storey to match current engine constraints. All critical paths have accessible ramps and redundant manual releases.

scenes.title: The place it remembers
scenes.stage: Wide approach from the truck, then follow Cal and TayJ through a ground-level service door. The camera pauses at inside-facing manual release markings. Amber Road Force presence is thin here, not triumphant.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: This is where they held me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You want to bring her into another cage?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I want to use what can guide the field. Not what made escape impossible.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then the release stays reachable from both sides.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And nobody straps her down because it is convenient.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Medical support and field control are different systems. We keep them separate.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: I can take these locks out without taking the frame down.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Do it.

scenes.title: A room with exits
scenes.stage: Playable repairs. A 5-second tracking shot follows Dain pushing a stretcher along the complete entrance-to-platform route, demonstrating usable clearance. A 3-second insert hints at a broken capacitor mount only after the system survey.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: No raised threshold. No blind corner. We can roll someone out without turning them upright.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: That matters more than making it look impressive.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Guidance clamps intact. Reserve storage is not.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We can salvage the replacements marked at the ridge?

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Yes. And test them here before we commit.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Enough stored capacity will keep my earlier losses from deciding her fate.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Good. Because she never got a say in those either.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: No. She did not.

scenes.title: The old recording
scenes.stage: Player opens a sealed historical recorder. It identifies the Road Force's bargain but stops before its full confession; next mission provides corroboration. Camera follows Cal taking the recorder outside for a crew conversation, not a surprise jump scare.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: We can break the containment. In return, you put us in contact with the other presence.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can open a way. You do not understand what may answer.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: Then help us understand it after you are free.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That was you.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We are keeping the whole recording.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No riddles. No more tomorrow. Tell us now.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I will.

missions.title: The Bargain
missions.goal: Expose the Road Force's responsibility and independently verify its failed intervention.
steps: Hear the full admission
Listen with the crew and ask direct follow-up questions.
Corroborate the history
Compare resistance logs, containment damage and experiment dates.
Decide working trust
Set explicit consent and disclosure terms for continued cooperation.
object_hint: damage_log
The attempted shutdown is dated after the first exposure, before Grevyn's transfer.
missions.choice: Forgive, cooperate without forgiveness or remain openly distrustful. All retain the rescue route; forgiveness is not a survival key.
missions.recovery: No irreversible decision until the confession and corroboration are in the journal. Skipping the cinematic preserves a full readable summary.

scenes.title: What freedom cost
scenes.stage: Static group composition in the dismantled containment room. The Road Force speaks without a beautiful visual distraction. Camera holds on listeners between lines. Its explanation does not claim it intended the experiments.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: They had weakened me until I could barely reach beyond this room. I offered contact with the other force for my freedom.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You opened the way.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Did you know they would use people?

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Not then. I knew the other presence was dangerous. I wanted to be free more than I wanted to keep asking.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn paid for what you stopped asking.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: When did you find out? Not when you felt bad. When did you know?

scenes.title: An attempt that did not erase it
scenes.stage: Player compares three independent logs. A brief object-focused shot shows fused relay contacts corresponding to a documented shutdown attempt. Road Force's failure is true and does not undo its initiating bargain.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: While the experiments were happening. I tried to break the field and remove the subjects. I failed.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: The road presence cut our supply feed. We rebuilt it under regime protection.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: That matches the failure log. It does not clear either of them.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You wanted me to trust you before I knew any of this.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I feared you would leave her if you learned why I knew where she was.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not get to make that choice for me.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: From here: cost, risk, alternatives. Before, not after.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Agreed.

scenes.title: Work without absolution
scenes.stage: Player chooses Cal's response. Camera remains at eye level and returns before selection. Crew support is not withdrawn for anger. A working compact is written beside the rescue checklist.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I believe you tried. I am not ready to call this all right.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will work with you to help her. That is not forgiveness.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I do not trust you. TayJ checks every claim, and you answer every question.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Those are terms I can accept.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Grevyn gets the same truth when she can hear it safely.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: All of it. Even if she tells us to leave.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Then we plan a treatment she can understand, not another bargain made over her.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: That is what I should have done before.

missions.title: Terms of the Rescue
missions.goal: Rehearse severing, disclose the sacrifice cost and verify a guaranteed preparation route remains open.
steps: Run a dry test
Test support and containment separately without a person on the platform.
Learn all three routes
Review prepared severing, emergency treatment and fatal transfer.
Finish staging
Place a spare vehicle, medical support and power reserve; leave a recovery itinerary.
object_hint: test_dummy
The weighted test cradle is for equipment checks, not a person.
missions.choice: Choose an intended plan now, revisable at M35. Explain that transfer kills Cal, and successful severing consumes the Road Force.
missions.recovery: Display unmet conditions and routes to fix them. Do not permit a ceremonial yes to silently lock a later sacrifice.

scenes.title: The empty platform
scenes.stage: Follow Cal wheeling a test cradle into position, then step out to a wide view of clear exits and manual releases. Run no live field against a person. Each indicator has a text label and sound distinct from an alarm.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Guidance stable. Manual release works from the platform.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Body support remains on when guidance is cut. That is the separation we need.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: A successful test is evidence. It is not consent from the person who will use it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We ask her when she can answer.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: There is another cost you need to know.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then say it now.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: A complete severing will consume what remains of me.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: That goes in the plan too.

scenes.title: The choice nobody owes
scenes.stage: Static table conversation. Explicit fatal-sacrifice explanation, no heroic swell urging selection. Player can ask again. The supernatural transfer mechanism is stated as a voluntary channel, not a blood ritual or real-world method.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: If her bond cannot be severed safely, you could take its connection into yourself. I could destroy it there.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And me.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Yes. You would die. She would still need bodily support.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You are not a spare part, Cal. Do not decide that because you are tired or guilty.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Prepared Golghis and working equipment can let both of you live. That route is still open.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I want that route. I want to live.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Then we keep building it.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: No one owes this sacrifice. Not even to repair what I did.

scenes.title: Leave a way back
scenes.stage: Follow TayJ placing the recovery itinerary on the truck dashboard. Player stages fuel, replacement parts and a second receiver. No hidden force-reserve requirement remains after this inspection.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Return fuel sealed. Spare battery charged. Truck can leave without the station grid.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: If we have to come back for supplies, we know exactly where.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And if you change your mind, you say it. Even at the last moment before the procedure.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I hear you.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We have a plan. We do not have to pretend it is easy.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: She is at the reconstruction facility now. The other force is keeping her close.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we find her. And we let her speak.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Crew check. Everybody here.

missions.title: The Regime's Future
missions.goal: Enter the reconstruction complex and expose Grandpa Gucki's bargain with the Dominion.
steps: Approach with faction support
Use earned civilian routes or complete a local service bypass.
Collect the command record
Recover Grandpa's knowing authorization and current conditioning orders.
Reach the audience wing
Disable the perimeter relay without cutting medical support.
object_hint: command_record
The signed authorization is in the command desk's locked side drawer.
missions.choice: Publicly release regime orders with protected victim identities or deliver them to independent settlements. Both preserve accountability.
missions.recovery: No forced combat loadout. Support, stealth and vehicle diversion routes reach the same protected rendezvous.

scenes.title: A government rebuilding itself
scenes.stage: Wide shows the complex's flags and restored power grid. Follow Cal moving past a truck checkpoint using the chosen route; never reveal a free-roam roadblock as this fixed authored site. Propaganda music is diegetic and can be muted separately.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: The roads will be one road. The people will be one people. Protection begins with obedience.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: He still calls it protection.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: The settlements gave us a service route. They did not give him their consent.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Diversion truck ready if you need it.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Medical line stays live. I am watching its feed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Perimeter only. We do not cut life support to make an entrance.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: The other presence is here.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then stay with what you can prove. We are past trusting a feeling.

scenes.title: A willing bargain
scenes.stage: Command records and a recent recorded confrontation reveal both parties. Shot over Cal's shoulder keeps the document readable; cut to the screen only when he chooses playback. Grandpa is not an innocent possessed leader.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: You said the conditioned population would hold the field. I kept the dosing program alive.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: And they obeyed because they feared what came without it. Your state has been generous.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: It is my state.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: That is the phrase which made you easiest to keep.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: He knew. He kept paying it with people.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: And Grevyn was meant to make the next generation of the system stable.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Record secured. Victim identities protected before transmission.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then he does not get to say he was deceived.

scenes.title: The friend already inside
scenes.stage: Audience-wing door. Riped's voice is audible ahead, calling Cal dangerous. Follow Cal to the doorway for 4 seconds; stop before he can see Grevyn. Return control for the final medical and evidence check.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: He has been collecting weapons and stories. I tried to stop him. He thinks you are not yourself.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal would not come this far without a reason.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Exactly. Do not let him get close.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Riped.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: He did not use the rendezvous. He came here.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Cal, breathe. Do not walk in angry with your hands full.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Evidence case. Empty hands. Let her see me.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can keep a path open. I cannot choose what she hears.

missions.title: You Never Came Back
missions.goal: Meet the living, changed Grevyn; present the frame-up evidence while respecting her distance and disbelief.
steps: Approach without force
Place weapons outside the room and remain behind Grevyn's marked distance.
Present a full chronology
Offer originals, unedited audio, false voucher and treatment records.
Make room for truth
Show Cal's scar only with consent and let Grevyn question both men.
object_hint: evidence_table
The clear table is outside Grevyn's reach line; set the case there.
missions.choice: Cal can be hurt, angry or measured; no exact phrase makes her magically trust him. All corroborated evidence reaches her.
missions.recovery: Dialogue selection is untimed. A tense camera is not a QTE. If skipped, required facts still display before the next authored scene.

scenes.title: Cal
scenes.stage: Grevyn stands at the far end of a damaged audience hall. Slowly track behind Cal entering, then settle into a wide with Riped between them. Her use of Cal triggers his anxiety; the camera steadies instead of simulating dizziness without permission.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Do not— I need a second.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: See? He is not ready for this.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not get to speak for me.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You did not come back. Do not come here and call that care.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I tried. I also said things on that call I wish I had not said.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You told me fine.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I did. It was anger. It was not permission for what they did to you.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Put the case down. Stay there.

scenes.title: Everything except a verdict
scenes.stage: Object-by-object evidence sequence. Cal walks only to the agreed table. Inserts show paired documents and full audio; camera returns to Grevyn between exhibits, allowing her to react and ask. No friendship montage substitutes for proof.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: This is the protective request. This is the version they filed. Same signature. Different order.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You could have made that after.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: The carbon predates the detention. The archive kept both. You can check the custody marks.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: She is helping him tell a story.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Let her finish.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The full radio channel. The civilian note with its patient sheet. The payment voucher copied from another account.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: They showed me your handwriting.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It was mine. The lie was what they put around it.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And these are my treatment notes from the night he tried to reach you.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You were there?

scenes.title: Where he was hit
scenes.stage: Cal asks before showing the healed gunshot scar. Brief neutral framing, then dress restored. The treatment card and rescue route remain visible; the script explicitly does not treat a scar as proof of who framed him. Riped feels his explanation slipping.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I can show you where I was shot. Do you want to see?

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Second road. The first was destroyed. The western one was blocked.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We have the route and the time we picked him up. They match the treatment record.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I remember you not coming. I remember hearing you. I cannot make it stop changing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not have to fix the memory to read what happened.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Enough. He has dragged everybody into this because he cannot bear being the bad guy.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Why did you tell me he wanted me dead?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Because I know him.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then tell her what you knew about Drywell.

missions.title: The Informer
missions.goal: Expose Riped's betrayal; stage Grevyn's lethal rage, injurious fall, brief lucid reunion and renewed control.
steps: Corroborate the release
Let TayJ deliver the restored prison release authorization.
Hear the confession
Riped reveals the private details and jealousy while believing Grevyn cannot hear.
Reach Grevyn after the fall
Allow Tay to stabilize her after she kills Riped and loses consciousness.
object_hint: release_audio
The restored release entry arrives on the paired receiver; play it at the table.
missions.choice: No kill-or-spare Riped choice: his death is fixed canon. Cal can protest or freeze, neither is graded as consent.
missions.recovery: Checkpoint before confession and after stabilization. Non-graphic fatal impact. Grevyn's severe injuries persist through every later mission.

scenes.title: A wall opened for him
scenes.stage: A brief power surge partitions the hall with translucent field geometry. Grevyn appears withdrawn; Riped believes she cannot hear. Keep sightlines intelligible in a wide. TayJ plays Voss's release order before Riped speaks.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Release authorization restored. Riped, cooperation agreement. Cell breach scheduled after transfer.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Release the cooperating witness. Open his wall after removal. Reed is to believe he escaped.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You let me go looking for your cell.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: And you did. Even then. You always need to be the person who comes back.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You knew she was alive.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Of course I knew. You would never have stopped if I had told you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Because there was never room for anyone else when she had you.

scenes.title: The detail only one friend should know
scenes.stage: Tight two-shot Cal and Riped, then reveal Grevyn listening beyond the field. Riped names every private detail he overheard and the planted evidence; not a magical truth spell. His jealousy explains motive without excusing it.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Behind the history map. Save me the window seat. Drywell, western canopy, service road. You said it all in one conversation.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You were outside the door.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: I listened. I used your token, changed the report, gave them the route. Your note and a few radio cuts did the rest.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You sold her out because she trusted me?

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Because you both made me nothing. She told you everything and I got the joke afterward.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.direction: from beyond the field, lucid horror
lines.text: I told him. Not you.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Grevyn. You were not supposed to—

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You let me hate him. You came here and did it again.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Come on. I got you through it, did I not?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn, look at me. You do not have to listen to him anymore.

scenes.title: Lightning
scenes.stage: Wide camera follows Grevyn rising 3 m, staying outside a 5 m electrical safety radius. Cold arcs circle her; reduced-flash mode uses continuous ribbons and bass tremor. She grabs Riped with the field and slams him once to the floor. Cut to Cal at contact; Riped dies instantly, no gore or ragdoll comedy.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.direction: rage, not a scream on every word
lines.text: You knew. All that time. You knew.

lines.speaker: RIPED
lines.text: Put me down. Grevyn, I can explain—

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn! Stop!

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You do not get to explain me away.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Cal, stay clear of the field!

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Grevyn? Grevyn, look at me.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: The surge is leaving her. Clear the fall.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: No. No, not from that high.

scenes.title: A minute of her own
scenes.stage: She loses consciousness and falls onto broken floor, severely injuring her torso and leg. Cal reaches her only after arcs cease. Tay enters from the cleared side with Sable's remote guidance. Use a 6-second floor-level follow of the stretcher team, then static faces. Do not let Cal catch her and erase the injury.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Do not lift her alone. Keep her head still. Cal, give me space at her side.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: She is breathing. Tell me she is breathing.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: She is. That does not mean she is all right.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal? I heard him. I heard all of it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am here.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I killed him.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.direction: not absolving or condemning in the crisis
lines.text: We deal with that when you are safe. Right now, stay with Tay.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I believed him. I said you left me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: It hurt. I still wanted you alive.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I do not know how to be who you came for.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You do not have to be her to let us help.

scenes.title: Not finished
scenes.stage: A low continuous field tone rises; Grevyn recognizes its return before losing control. The force moves her injured body unnaturally, never healing it. Gameplay resumes in a clear cover position with nonlethal objectives. No further click dismisses the entire confrontation.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: It is coming back. I can feel what it wants me to say.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Start monitored support. Keep the field input away from the injured side.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You have broken a servant. You have not broken the order.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal, get back. Not because I want you gone. Get back.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I hear you.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: Return the subject to her station.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Her injuries are still there. If it makes her stand, it is hurting her.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Then we break its equipment. Not her.

missions.title: Break the Connection
missions.goal: Survive the controlled Grevyn's attack without attacking her; disable the local reinforcement relays.
steps: Reach cover
Move Tay and the injured Grevyn's support equipment behind grounded screens.
Disable three relays
Use mechanical isolation at west, service and dais feeds while avoiding field sweeps.
Open extraction
Let Road Force guide a safe corridor after capacity cost or use the installed screens.
object_hint: relay_isolator
Follow the floor cable to the labelled isolation handle, not the medical line.
missions.choice: Physical Road Force shielding costs one reserve unit after warning; manual grounding preserves reserve. Neither requires shooting Grevyn.
missions.recovery: Attacks telegraph with steady light, tone and floor trace. Downing resets to the room checkpoint, never permanently injures allies or rerolls the ending.

scenes.title: Her warning matters
scenes.stage: Gameplay starts behind grounded cover. A 4-second low follow along the floor cable shows the first isolator only after Grevyn's initial sweep stops. Cinematic does not take camera control while danger is active.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: The witness will return to compliance.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I heard you tell me to get back. I am listening this time.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: The floor. Do not cross the bright line.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Three reinforcement feeds. Medical support is separate. I marked the labels.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: She cannot take many more forced movements. We need the stretcher route.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: West feed first. Keep talking me through it.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Nothing fired at her. Nothing through her support line.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Understood.

scenes.title: The things around her
scenes.stage: Player shuts down relays one at a time. Between safe windows, follow Cal from cover to handle for no more than 3 seconds if cinematic assistance is enabled; otherwise maintain gameplay camera. Grevyn's involuntary motion slows with each feed.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: One down. Field is narrowing, not gone.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You were useful when you followed orders, Reed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That was the problem.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Do not let it make you prove something.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I will not.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can hold a shield for the crossing. One measure. The screens offer another path.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Both routes are open. Choose from cover.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Reinforcement off. Bring the stretcher.

scenes.title: Out of the room
scenes.stage: When threat pauses, a 6-second follow tracks Tay, Cal and the stretcher through the grounded corridor. No triumphant Grevyn standing animation. Her grip loosens and the field subsides, leaving her severely injured and conscious enough to consent to moving.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: My name is Tay. You know me from school. We need to move you with support. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Yes. Do not let it stand me up again.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We will use the stretcher.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Service doors open. Dain is ready.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You stayed.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am staying now. We can talk about then when we have a road under us.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: There is no road outside what I can reach.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: There are roads you did not build.

missions.title: The Passenger
missions.goal: Stabilize Grevyn, begin appropriate support and evacuate with ongoing consent where possible.
steps: Prepare transport
Secure stretcher, injury supports, support monitor and spare power.
Explain the substitute
Tell Grevyn what Golghis does and what remains unknown; obtain consent in a lucid interval.
Leave the complex
Load the medical vehicle and depart along the prepared route.
object_hint: stretcher_mount
Both locking pins must show seated before the vehicle can move.
missions.choice: Verified Golghis starts planned support; provisional stock remains explicitly emergency-only. If she cannot respond, use the least restrictive stabilization until she can.
missions.recovery: No case opening under gunfire. Support consumables are abstract fictional units; no real dosing or medical instructions.

scenes.title: Ask her
scenes.stage: Sheltered loading bay. Static eye-level framing between Tay and Grevyn; Cal remains visible without dominating the conversation. No camera angle makes an injured woman an exhibit. Sable explains through an identified radio channel.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Grevyn, I have your corrected research. Golghis supports the damage without strengthening the bond.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Did you use the west-marked pages?

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: All three corrected checks. I can show you the verification record.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Then yes. I want the support. I want it out of me.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Do not call the provisional batch ready. I wrote the warning for a reason.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We have a recovery route. We can still finish it.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Then do not let being close make you stop thinking.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We will tell you before every next step.

scenes.title: A place in the van
scenes.stage: Follow the stretcher rails into the medical vehicle over 5 seconds, ending on a locking pin. Return control for both lock checks. Tay takes the treatment seat, Cal can drive the escort truck or ride briefly while Dain drives.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Rails seated. Rear power is independent. We can leave if the grid fails.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You check the second pin. I check her support.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Second pin seated.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: The place they first held the Road Force. We removed the locks. It has equipment that can guide the severing.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Another facility.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: With an exit we control. You can see it before anything starts.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Keep telling me where we are.

scenes.title: Not fine
scenes.stage: As vehicles idle safely, Grevyn calls Cal by his nickname; he names the anxiety without blaming her for using it. Camera stays steady. Their friendship is unresolved and neither promises immediate reconciliation.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Cal?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Give me a second. Hearing you say it brings the call back.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I can stop.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: For now, maybe use Callum. It is not a punishment.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Callum. Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Thank you for asking.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Road clear. Scheduled check-in at the western marker.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We move when Tay says she is secured.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Secured. Slow departure.

missions.title: The Longest Drive
missions.goal: Bring Grevyn to the prepared site through pursuit, forced-memory anomalies and quiet intervals.
steps: Clear the pursuit
Use prepared civilian diversion routes or disable pursuer vehicles without involving civilians.
Anchor the real road
Navigate field intrusions using TayJ's physical markers and vehicle telemetry.
Reach the first prison
Make a safe support stop and complete the final approach.
object_hint: ground_marker
The striped post is real; the repeated school doorway is a memory intrusion.
missions.choice: Drive escort, medical van or a split-convoy segment at different stages. Crew travel changes naturally, preserving player vehicle choice when practical.
missions.recovery: No endless chase requiring every vehicle killed. Authored break-contact conditions are distance plus disabled tracking feed; crashes are simulated safely away from civilians.

scenes.title: A road with company
scenes.stage: Begin with a rear-left follow of the two vehicles only while safely stationary, then hand driving back before the first threat. Radio voices are clear over engines. Enemy collisions use existing vehicle simulation, not lethal cutscene rails through traffic.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Two pursuit vehicles. Civilian turn is clear. Do not lead them through the crossing.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: I can block the service fork after you pass.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Keep the van moving. I will take the outside line.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Her support is holding. No hard turns if you can avoid them.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: They are following the tower signal. Not your tail lights.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: She is right. Repeater on the ridge. We cut it and break sight.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Good catch.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I was paying attention too.

scenes.title: The classroom in the road
scenes.stage: Optional cinematic shows a school doorway reflected in the windshield, never replacing the physical road collider. Player retains steering. A brief safe-stop insert recalls the real striped marker. Reduced-effects setting uses subtitle and sound distortion instead of visual warping.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You can stop trying. There is a version where you never left that room.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That room is not here. The marker is here.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Three close posts, one striped. Road bends right beyond the fourth.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: It shows me things I want to believe. Do not argue with the picture. Follow the post.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I hear you.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Both of you, breathe with the engine idle when we stop. No one has to win this in one breath.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I can hold the signal. The driving belongs to you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: That is enough.

scenes.title: A quiet kilometer
scenes.stage: After breaking contact, music loses percussion. Player may stop at a marked turnout without a biological countdown. Follow Cal walking from escort truck to van for 5 seconds, then return for a brief check-in. End at the containment-site gate.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I used to imagine finding you and having the right thing ready to say.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Was it better than this?

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Usually I got as far as being angry. Then I ran out of words.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I am still angry. Not all of it knows where to go.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: We do not have to solve that before the next kilometer.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: That is a good plan for both of you.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Site gate ahead. Dain has the lights on.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I can see the exit from here.

missions.title: Containment
missions.goal: Give Grevyn the full truth, repair every known gap and obtain informed consent before final treatment.
steps: Set the room
Position the medical platform, release wheel and monitors; test three reserve capacitors as needed.
Tell the truth
Explain Road Force's bargain, costs, all viable procedures and available recovery routes.
Choose readiness
Review the explicit checklist; freely leave to repair gaps before sealing the consent record.
object_hint: readiness_board
The board beside the release wheel lists exactly what remains missing.
missions.choice: All choices remain reversible here. Grevyn hears the Road Force's responsibility and may be angry while still consenting to treatment.
missions.recovery: Emergency risk is displayed as a design probability before selection. Full preparation is deterministic, never a hidden dice roll.

scenes.title: The room is yours to inspect
scenes.stage: Follow Grevyn's stretcher at eye height through the site, 6 seconds, then show the reachable release wheel from her actual viewpoint. Cal remains outside her personal space until invited. Visible readiness board identifies each missing condition.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Here is the release. Guidance stops, medical support stays on.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: No locks?

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Removed. I can show you the pile.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We can delay. Nothing starts because the room is ready.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: There is something else you need to hear. The Road Force helped open contact with the thing controlling you.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: For my freedom. I discovered the experiments while they happened and failed to stop them.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You wanted out. So did I.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: I know. What I wanted does not excuse what it cost you.

scenes.title: No better words than the truth
scenes.stage: Static full-crew conversation. Show the exact preparedness check after Sable's explanation. The emergency route is clearly marked 65% survival in this production design, subject to pre-release balance testing; no chance in the prepared route.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Verified Golghis, stable support, working guidance and enough reserve. With these conditions met, the planned procedure does not depend on a survival lottery.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: We have gaps. We can still repair them. The emergency attempt would give her a sixty-five percent chance of surviving the severing.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Then show me what we can fix before you ask whether I will take that risk.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Every missing item has a marked recovery stop. No path has closed behind us.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Transfer remains another possibility. It would kill Callum and consume me. It would not heal her injuries.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Do not offer his life like an item on your bench.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Nobody is choosing it for me. I want us both to leave.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Then we take the time the safer plan needs.

scenes.title: Consent is a conversation
scenes.stage: Player may leave and return with repairs. On final confirmation Grevyn chooses severing without Cal selecting her answer for her; she has received all facts. Fatally transferring requires a separate later Cal confirmation, never this general consent.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I want the connection gone. I understand what you can do and what you cannot promise.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: And if you tell us stop before the severing, we stop.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Is there anything you want before we begin?

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Water. A quieter room. And no one telling me this makes everything worth it.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Water I can do. Quiet too.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am here. She is here. Read the board once more, then choose.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am reading it.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: For once, let the choice belong to the people living with it.

missions.title: The Severing
missions.goal: Resolve the connection through prepared severing, a clearly risky emergency attempt or voluntary fatal transfer.
steps: Confirm the route
Choose repair and return, prepared severing, disclosed emergency risk or a separately confirmed fatal transfer.
Run the procedure
Operate TayJ's guidance sequence while Tay and Sable maintain support.
Commit the outcome
Resolve once, persist result, consume the Road Force and continue to the appropriate aftermath.
object_hint: guidance_handle
The guidance control is the amber wheel; the medical support lever stays untouched.
missions.choice: Prepared route succeeds deterministically. Emergency uses one persisted 65% draw. Cal's fatal transfer saves Grevyn only with bodily support verified, so restore that first.
missions.recovery: Procedure input failure pauses or resets to its last safe phase without randomizing survival. Fatal outcome commits before cutscene; reload cannot reroll emergency result.

scenes.title: One more chance to change course
scenes.stage: Static readiness screen with spoken confirmation. Hold to confirm for fatal transfer after an explicit cancelable summary; no time pressure or preselected sacrifice. Emergency random result is stored at irreversible start before any animation.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Planned severing confirmed. Support stable. We proceed when Grevyn says.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Proceed.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Emergency attempt. Sixty-five percent survival. We can still stop and repair the gaps now.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I understand. If we do this, do not hide the result from him.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am choosing the transfer. I understand I will die. Not because she owes me, and not because I think my life is worthless.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: You are loved here, Cal. I need you to know that before you choose it again.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I know. I wish there were another way we were willing to take. I am choosing this one.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I do not want your death to be the proof you cared.

lines.speaker: CAL

lines.speaker: TAYJ

scenes.title: Hold the line
scenes.stage: Procedure gameplay uses three labelled guidance actions with no twitch requirement. Follow Cal from console to side rail for 4 seconds only during a safe phase. Grevyn stays supported. The Dominion appears as cold geometry pulling toward the ceiling; Road Force amber holds its edge, not a giant boss health bar.

lines.speaker: TAY

lines.text: I can give you a world that will never leave you again.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: You gave me a room I could not leave. That is not the same thing.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Follow her corrected pattern. West, not north.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Corrected pattern stable. Continue when ready.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: It will offer you certainty. Keep the things you can check.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Guidance two. Guidance three. Holding.

scenes.title: Both alive
scenes.stage: Only PREPARED or EMERGENCY_SUCCESS. Amber field dissolves steadily into the road seams. Grevyn remains injured on the platform; no sudden walking recovery. Hold a quiet wide after the bond breaks, then faces. Road Force dies completing the severing.

lines.speaker: ROAD

lines.speaker: ROAD

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: TAY

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Do not move her yet. Survival is the start of treatment, not the end.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: Okay. We have a start.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Recording the time. Recording that you are both here.

scenes.title: The transfer
scenes.stage: Only TRANSFER. With bodily support verified, Cal willingly receives the supernatural connection through the field rig. No real-world self-injury mechanism. Static two-shot across the platform, warm amber then darkness. Road Force destroys the transferred bond; Cal dies. Do not frame his death as punishment for depression.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: Connection transferred. I can finish it here.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I am scared. That does not change what I chose.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Callum. I am here. I hear you.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I know. Stay with them.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: We have you, Cal. You are not alone.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I am keeping the whole record. All of you.

lines.speaker: ROAD
lines.text: No more bargains.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: The bond is gone. Grevyn's support is holding.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: Cal is gone.

scenes.stage: Only EMERGENCY_FAILURE. The Road Force completes the severing but Grevyn does not survive the physiological collapse. Sable and Tay attempt care off the dramatic beat; a respectful time transition makes the medical outcome clear. No player button is blamed for the random result.

lines.speaker: GREVYN

lines.speaker: CAL

lines.speaker: CAL

missions.title: What Comes After
missions.goal: Resolve all four endings, show Grandpa and the Dominion destroying each other, and establish aftermath without erasing losses.
steps: Allow time
Play the medical recovery or grieving transition appropriate to the persisted outcome.
Speak honestly
If both survive, let Grevyn state her needs and choose Cal's response: together or separate.
Witness the wider ending
Show Grandpa's failed power grab, the Dominion's eventual death and the surviving communities.
object_hint: keepsake_box
The personal case is on the bedside table; open it only if you want the private recording.
missions.choice: Together is a platonic chosen future; separate is not failure. Death endings receive distinct aftermaths. Freeroam after Cal's death uses a labelled pre-finale save, never resurrection.
missions.recovery: Ending choice saves before credits. Grand finale never reverses a committed death or removes regime remnants from later play.

scenes.title: The man who wanted his state back
scenes.stage: Audience-only cutscene after severing, explicitly intercut elsewhere. Grandpa escapes the broken reconstruction facility and reaches his field-control chamber. Follow him entering, 5 seconds; close view of a previously established emergency rupture control, then a wide of the confrontation.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: I gave you a population. A state. You will not leave me ruling ruins.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You gave me fear. You called the arrangement leadership.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: Then I end the arrangement.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You are inside it.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: So are you.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: You do not understand what you have broken.

lines.speaker: GUCKI
lines.text: I understand enough.

lines.speaker: EVIL
lines.text: Then understand this.

scenes.title: What a dying force leaves
scenes.stage: The Dominion kills Grandpa through the field as his rupture rig fatally damages it. No instant victory heals Grevyn retroactively. A time-lapse of failing cold grid lines over several days establishes the force dying out. Surviving Trooper units abandon some posts and retain others.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: Reconstruction command is silent. Gucki is dead. The field keeps shrinking.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: The rupture damaged its source. It is dying, not traveling to another host.

lines.speaker: NESS
lines.text: Troopers still hold two junctions. We do not call those people free until they can leave.

lines.speaker: DAIN
lines.text: Then we keep the crossings open.

lines.speaker: MERRIN
lines.text: Put my orders in the record too. Do not clean the resistance out of this history.

lines.speaker: ORIN
lines.text: No one account gets to own what happened.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Especially not his. He did not save me by killing the thing he fed.

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: And its death does not make hers smaller.

scenes.title: If both survive: the conversation
scenes.stage: Weeks later, Grevyn in rehabilitation, Cal rested but still anxious. Static two-shot at a shaded roadside table with mobility support nearby. She may want connection without promising restored trust. Player sees together and separate as equal, explicit choices.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I want a life that is not built around what they did. I do not know yet where that is.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I wanted finding you to explain the missing years. It did not give them back.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I still have things to answer for. Riped is dead because of what I did. Being controlled does not make every consequence disappear.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: And I have service records to face that no forged report can explain away.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: I would like to know you now. Slowly. I can do that nearby or from somewhere else.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I want to try nearby. As friends. With room to say when it is too much.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: I want you alive in the world. I also need to build a life that is not waiting for your next call. We should leave separately.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: Then slowly. No pretending the old seat was empty all this time.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: All right. I can be sad about that and still respect it.

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: So can I.

scenes.title: Together
scenes.stage: Only TOGETHER. Months later, medical progress is modest and believable. Follow Cal and Grevyn walking a short distance to the crew vehicle; mobility aid remains as needed. TayJ calls from the relay, Tay packs for a clinic visit. No romantic kiss, coupling achievement or implied cure for Cal's mental health.

scenes.title: Separate
scenes.stage: Only SEPARATE. At the crossing, Grevyn leaves with a rehabilitation convoy while Cal stays with his crew. Follow each departure in two equally lit shots, not a bleak-versus-golden moral contrast. A later letter confirms mutual voluntary contact.

lines.speaker: GREVYN

lines.speaker: TAY
lines.text: How are you doing?

lines.speaker: CAL

lines.speaker: TAYJ

lines.speaker: CAL
lines.text: You have been waiting to say that.

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: I wrote it down. Obviously.

scenes.title: If Cal died
scenes.stage: Only TRANSFER. Weeks later Grevyn joins Tay and TayJ at a private memorial, still in treatment. A static wide gives all three equal space. Her future includes accountability and friendship, not a romantic bereavement identity. Cal's private recordings are shared only according to his stated wishes.

lines.speaker: TAY

lines.speaker: TAY

lines.speaker: GREVYN

lines.speaker: TAYJ
lines.text: We can start with today.

lines.speaker: GREVYN
lines.text: He came back. I wish he could have left with us.

scenes.title: If Grevyn died
scenes.stage: Only FAILURE. Cal at a quiet community memorial; no solitary desert walk as a glamorous disappearance. Tay and TayJ stay nearby without speaking for him. Grevyn's work supports other survivors with attribution and privacy, not a cure-all.
